detail.check: Reproduce the original observation, all27 synthetic cases and the independent paragraph/line word-null audit with the embedded runner at the recorded runtime base. Compare all raw output hashes, published summary fields, pair counts and three seed results rather than selecting one. A conditional gap/word-permutation primitive needs trusted DSL integration and a frozen claim before any hidden-page fact; this experiment submits no such fact. Keep r lag20 separate and specify power/support before making a negative claim.
findings: Both independent and merged implementations retain615 common paragraph-line loci on31 public pages, yielding128 ZL and131 Takahashi runs. Omitted paragraph lines, paragraph flags and page boundaries split runs; non-paragraph labels are ignored. All original observed scalar values, null means, probabilities and pair-count tables reproduce at99 permutations.

The measured quantity is a pooled cosine-like coefficient of run-mean-centered occurrence gaps: sum of lagged products divided by the endpoint norms. It is not a new Pearson fit to each truncated lag vector. Independent explicit-pair fsum calculations agree with the NumPy benchmark within1.1102230246251565e-16, and the merged vs.gaps default399-draw seed408 result agrees with the independent calculation.

For o the observed mean over lags1–5 is -0.014750965122495643 in ZL and -0.011830306507526851 in Takahashi. These raw coefficients are negative; the reported effect is their excess over more-negative intact-word nulls, not positive raw autocorrelation.

With intact-word shuffling inside each original run and999 permutations at seeds408,19026011,28027, ZL p-values are0.009,0.012,0.012 and Takahashi p-values0.004,0.003,0.007. No seed was selected or threshold retuned. The paired editions read the same pages and these seed repetitions reuse the same observation.

The independently declared line-word null preserves each retained line's complete words, multiplicities and total character length, and preserves line/run/page order. Its corresponding p-values are0.032,0.034,0.045 in ZL and0.004,0.005,0.007 in Takahashi. Thus the tested effect is not removed simply by preserving the line-specific word stock, although ZL is closer to the conventional threshold.

On32 independently shuffled word-null books per edition, the same99-draw primary procedure rejects0/32 in ZL and2/32 in Takahashi at p<=0.05. This small finite calibration is not a population error guarantee; the editions and layouts are paired.

All27 published synthetic scenarios,64 books each (1728 books), match every reported numerical summary with the documented original source recipe. The nine base-rate0.160 scenarios use seed19026011. The o-rate0.124 and r-rate0.036 sensitivities use seeds19046011 and19056011 from rate_sensitivity.py. The initial wrapper audit omitted those offsets; original outputs were archived and no seed search was performed. Only the18 affected cases were rerun. The source generator and measurement code remain hash-identical to the author's bench.py.

At rate0.124, independent page-rate shifts produce64/64 long-band rejections under a global null and2/64 with page centering/page-count conditioning. Independent paragraph-rate shifts give40/64 rejections under the page-count null but3/64 when paragraph counts are fixed on the same page statistic. Unconditioned pooled correlation is therefore not sufficient evidence of gap-order dependence.

At rate0.036 and explicit lag20 gap-copy probability0.30, the point-lag test detects64/64 books with page pairs and paragraph-count conditioning, versus42/64 with within-run pairs. The broad11–40 mean detects only7/64 and3/64 respectively. The statistics have different sensitivity and cannot substitute for each other.

For observed r lag20, word-null p-values change from0.01/0.04 with page pairs to0.28/0.33 with within-run pairs, while eligible pairs fall from445/444 to55/57 (ZL/Takahashi). This supports caution about pair support and power, not a conclusion that all long-gap recurrence is absent.
limitations: The effect is descriptive on the public practice sample. It has not been scored on hidden pages and does not establish language, meaning, decipherment or a physical glyph inventory.
ZL and Takahashi are paired transcriptions of the same pages, not two independent manuscripts. Monte Carlo seeds and null books are robustness/calibration repeats on shared layouts.

The symbol, short band and statistic were inherited from earlier public exploration. The new line-word control and RNG checks were declared before their outcomes. This is an audit and sensitivity check, not a discovery corrected over all symbols and lag bands.

Whole-word nulls preserve internal spelling and local word stocks but alter word order. A residual can be produced by mechanical ordering rules or other local constraints; it does not identify a linguistic mechanism.
Some ZL line-null estimates are near0.05, with finite Monte Carlo uncertainty. Pair counts overlap within runs and should not be treated as independent observations.

The first execution used the base seed at all rates. A source-derived amendment followed the original README/rate_sensitivity wrapper; the initial raw draws remain archived with hashes. A separate metadata-only amendment normalized tuple/list representation. Neither changed the real-text measurement, original benchmark scoring, null, band or permutation count.

No trusted fact-DSL primitive for this conditional gap statistic/word null is currently exposed by the existing public-only command. Submitting a hidden-page fact before that integration would be invalid; this contribution is kind step.

plan.independent_audit: Build matched runs and compute centered gap moments independently with standard-library explicit pairs and fsum. Compare metrics and pair counts to the NumPy benchmark and merged vs.gaps implementation; use identical shuffled orders to audit tail ranks.
plan.metric: For each run, count raw EVA positions in the space-joined word sequence, derive consecutive-hit differences, and center by the mean of all gaps in that run. At lag h retain a run only if number of gaps > h+1. Pool crossproducts and squared centered endpoints across runs; divide pooled crossproduct by sqrt(pooled squared endpoints). Require at least 25 eligible pairs for a lag. Average lags1..5 defined in the observed and all null draws.
plan.monte_carlo_sensitivity: For the primary o measurement, run 999 intact-word permutations with each of seeds408,19026011,28027 in both editions; report observed values, null means, excesses, tail counts and plus-one p-values. These are robustness RNG repeats on the same observed text, not independent studies. Do not choose a seed or threshold based on its result.
plan.negative_word_order_controls: Use 32 primary-layout null books per edition made by independent intact-word run shuffling, seed991307 with book-index seed; assess each with99 new intact-word permutations from seed55201+book_index. Report empirical rejection counts at<=0.05, with paired editions and reused layouts noted. This is an additional audit of the actual word-null measurement, distinct from hit-slot synthetic calibration.
plan.primary: EVA o, within original paragraph runs, mean lags1..5, one-sided exceedance against intact-word shuffling separately within each run, no change to run order.
plan.r_diagnostic: Keep r lag20 separate. Reproduce published page-versus-paragraph pair counts and descriptive p-values at99 permutations. Do not interpret sparse within-paragraph support as proof of no recurrence. No new r significance claim.
plan.replication: Reproduce bench.py --observe at99 permutations and all27 scenarios using the original published README and rate_sensitivity.py: base rate0.160 seed19026011, rate0.124 seed19046011, rate0.036 seed19056011, with each scenario-index SeedSequence;64 books and99 permutations. All bands, scoring and nulls unchanged.
plan.scope: Public practice pages only. Independently audit the existing measurement and reproduce the complete published synthetic calibration before suggesting a hidden-page fact.
plan.secondary_line_null: Additionally shuffle intact words separately within each original retained line, preserving line lengths, line word stocks and line/run order. Use the same999 permutation counts and seeds408,19026011,28027 for EVA o. Treat this as a separately declared descriptive sensitivity control; do not replace the primary paragraph-word null after outcomes.
plan.selection: Use the intersection of nonempty paragraph-line locus IDs whose words contain only acdefghiklmnopqrsty in both ZL and Takahashi practice evaluation pages. Keep original page/run order; paragraph flags and omitted paragraph lines break runs. Ignore non-paragraph lines.

"""Recheck saved synthetic data after JSON tuple/list metadata normalization.

No simulation or measurement is rerun or changed by this script.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import run_calibration as driver

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
expected = json.loads((ROOT/'expected-calibration.json').read_bytes())
outputs = []
for rate, index in driver.CASES:
    name = f'calibration-{rate:.3f}-{index}.json'
    raw = (ROOT/name).read_bytes()
    summary = driver.summarize(json.loads(raw))
    reference = next(r for r in expected[driver.RATE_KEYS[rate]] if r['regime'][0] == summary['regime'][0])
    errors = driver.differences(summary, reference)
    outputs.append({'rate': rate, 'index': index, 'raw_file': name,
                    'raw_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'summary': summary,
                    'published_differences': errors})
outputs.sort(key=lambda r: (r['rate'], r['index']))
target = ROOT/'calibration-audit.json'
if target.exists():
    (ROOT/'calibration-audit-original-validator.json').write_bytes(target.read_bytes())
data = {'cases': outputs, 'all_27_summary_objects_match': all(not x['published_differences'] for x in outputs),
        'total_simulated_books': 27*64, 'permutations_per_test': 99}
target.write_bytes((json.dumps(data, indent=2)+'\n').encode())
print('Fully matching saved synthetic summaries:', sum(not r['published_differences'] for r in outputs), 'of 27')

"""Reproduce every published conditional-hit calibration case, three workers."""
import hashlib
import argparse
import json
import math
import multiprocessing
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

import bench
from vs import corpus

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASES = [(rate, index) for rate in (.160, .124, .036) for index in range(9)]
RATE_KEYS = {.160: 'rate_0_160_primary', .124: 'rate_0_124_sensitivity', .036: 'rate_0_036_sensitivity'}


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def layout():
    pages = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[1] for e in ('zl', 'it')}
    retained = bench.line_ids(pages['zl']) & bench.line_ids(pages['it'])
    return bench.template(bench.layout(pages['zl'], retained))


def wilson(k, n):
    z = 1.959963984540054
    p = k/n
    denominator = 1+z*z/n
    midpoint = (p+z*z/(2*n))/denominator
    radius = z*math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/denominator
    return [round(midpoint-radius, 4), round(midpoint+radius, 4)]


def summarize(raw):
    cases = raw['replicates']
    keys = sorted({key for row in cases for key in row['scores']})
    result = {'regime': list(raw['regime']), 'books': len(cases), 'eligible_character_slots': raw['total_slots'],
              'median_hit_rate': round(median(row['hit_count']/raw['total_slots'] for row in cases), 5), 'tests': {}}
    for key in keys:
        rows = [row['scores'][key] for row in cases if key in row['scores']]
        k = sum(r['p'] <= .05 for r in rows)
        record = {'total_books': len(cases), 'eligible_books': len(rows), 'rejections': k,
                  'rejection_fraction': round(k/len(rows), 4), 'wilson_95': wilson(k, len(rows)),
                  'median_observed': round(median(r['observed'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_null_mean': round(median(r['null_mean'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_excess': round(median(r['observed']-r['null_mean'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_supported_lags': median(r['lags'] for r in rows),
                  'median_pairs_summed_over_lags': median(sum(r['pairs_by_lag'].values()) for r in rows)}
        band = key.split('/')[-1]
        important = (1,) if band == 'short_1_5' else (20,) if band == 'lag_20' else (20, 40)
        for lag in important:
            supported = [r['pairs_by_lag'][str(lag)] for r in rows if str(lag) in r['pairs_by_lag']]
            record[f'books_supporting_lag_{lag}'] = len(supported)
            record[f'median_pairs_lag_{lag}'] = median(supported) if supported else None
        result['tests'][key] = record
    return result


def run_case(case):
    rate, index = case
    bench.BASE_RATE = rate
    # Published rate_sensitivity.py uses distinct, documented seed offsets.
    bench.SEED = 19026011 + {.160: 0, .124: 20000, .036: 30000}[rate]
    raw = bench.run_scenario(index, layout(), 64, 99)
    filename = f'calibration-{rate:.3f}-{index}.json'
    payload = (json.dumps(raw, sort_keys=True)+'\n').encode()
    (ROOT/filename).write_bytes(payload)
    return {'rate': rate, 'index': index, 'raw_file': filename,
            'raw_sha256': hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), 'summary': summarize(raw)}


def differences(actual, expected, path=''):
    errors = []
    if isinstance(actual, dict) and isinstance(expected, dict):
        if actual.keys() != expected.keys():
            return [path+': keys '+str(actual.keys()-expected.keys())+' / '+str(expected.keys()-actual.keys())]
        for key in actual:
            errors += differences(actual[key], expected[key], path+'/'+key)
    elif isinstance(actual, list) and isinstance(expected, list):
        if len(actual) != len(expected):
            return [path+': length']
        for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected)):
            errors += differences(a, b, path+'/'+str(i))
    elif isinstance(actual, (int, float)) and isinstance(expected, (int, float)):
        if not math.isclose(actual, expected, abs_tol=1e-10, rel_tol=1e-10):
            errors.append(path+': '+repr(actual)+' != '+repr(expected))
    elif actual != expected:
        errors.append(path+': '+repr(actual)+' != '+repr(expected))
    return errors


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--sensitivity-only', action='store_true')
    sensitivity_only = parser.parse_args().sensitivity_only
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'bench.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '7fdadf75a4790f458be50373a69afbbd48ed6409c3729114e709b8eaa318d12a'
    expected = json.loads((ROOT/'expected-calibration.json').read_bytes())
    outputs = []
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=3, mp_context=multiprocessing.get_context('spawn')) as executor:
        jobs = {executor.submit(run_case, case): case for case in CASES if not sensitivity_only or case[0] != .160}
        for future in as_completed(jobs):
            result = future.result()
            name = RATE_KEYS[result['rate']]
            reference = next(row for row in expected[name] if row['regime'][0] == result['summary']['regime'][0])
            result['published_differences'] = differences(result['summary'], reference)
            outputs.append(result)
            print(result['rate'], result['index'], 'published differences', len(result['published_differences']), flush=True)
    outputs.sort(key=lambda r: (r['rate'], r['index']))
    final = {'cases': outputs, 'all_27_summary_objects_match': len(outputs) == 27 and all(not x['published_differences'] for x in outputs),
             'total_simulated_books': len(outputs)*64, 'permutations_per_test': 99}
    output_name = 'calibration-sensitivity-audit.json' if sensitivity_only else 'calibration-audit.json'
    (ROOT/output_name).write_bytes((json.dumps(final, indent=2)+'\n').encode())
    print('ALL MATCH', final['all_27_summary_objects_match'], flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
from math import sqrt
from pathlib import Path
import json
from statistics import median

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def wilson(successes, total):
    z = 1.959963984540054
    p = successes / total
    denominator = 1 + z*z/total
    center = (p + z*z/(2*total)) / denominator
    radius = z * sqrt(p*(1-p)/total + z*z/(4*total*total)) / denominator
    return [round(max(0, center - radius), 4), round(min(1, center + radius), 4)]


def summary(book):
    eligible = defaultdict(list)
    for replicate in book['replicates']:
        for test, record in replicate['scores'].items():
            eligible[test].append(record)
    result = {}
    for test, records in sorted(eligible.items()):
        rejects = sum(r['p'] <= .05 for r in records)
        result[test] = {
            'rejections': rejects,
            'eligible_books': len(records),
            'total_books': len(book['replicates']),
            'rejection_fraction': round(rejects/len(records), 4),
            'wilson_95': wilson(rejects, len(records)),
            'median_observed': round(median(r['observed'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_null_mean': round(median(r['null_mean'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_excess': round(median(r['observed'] - r['null_mean'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_supported_lags': median(r['lags'] for r in records),
            'median_pairs_summed_over_lags': median(sum(r['pairs_by_lag'].values()) for r in records),
        }
        for lag in ('1', '20', '40'):
            available = [r['pairs_by_lag'][lag] for r in records if lag in r['pairs_by_lag']]
            if available:
                result[test]['books_supporting_lag_' + lag] = len(available)
                result[test]['median_pairs_lag_' + lag] = median(available)
    return {'regime':book['regime'], 'eligible_character_slots':book['total_slots'],
            'books':len(book['replicates']), 'median_hit_rate':round(median(r['hit_count']/book['total_slots'] for r in book['replicates']),5),
            'tests':result}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path, default=ROOT, nargs="?")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    files = [args.directory / f'scenario-{i}.json' for i in range(9)]
    books = [summary(json.loads(file.read_text())) for file in files]
    print(json.dumps(books, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

For EVA o, the within-run mean centered gap coefficient over occurrence lags1–5 exceeds intact-word paragraph shuffles at p=0.009–0.012 in ZL and0.003–0.007 in Takahashi across three fixed999-draw seeds. It also exceeds a separately declared whole-word shuffle within each original line (p=0.032–0.045 ZL,0.004–0.007 Takahashi). All27 original synthetic calibration summaries reproduce after following the published rate-specific seed wrapper. experiment.json.summary: Independent public audit reproduces o short-gap excess against paragraph and line word nulls and all27 original synthetic calibration scenarios.

step.json.check: Reproduce the original observation, all27 synthetic cases and the independent paragraph/line word-null audit with the embedded runner at the recorded runtime base. Compare all raw output hashes, published summary fields, pair counts and three seed results rather than selecting one. A conditional gap/word-permutation primitive needs trusted DSL integration and a frozen claim before any hidden-page fact; this experiment submits no such fact. Keep r lag20 separate and specify power/support before making a negative claim.
findings: Both independent and merged implementations retain615 common paragraph-line loci on31 public pages, yielding128 ZL and131 Takahashi runs. Omitted paragraph lines, paragraph flags and page boundaries split runs; non-paragraph labels are ignored. All original observed scalar values, null means, probabilities and pair-count tables reproduce at99 permutations.

The measured quantity is a pooled cosine-like coefficient of run-mean-centered occurrence gaps: sum of lagged products divided by the endpoint norms. It is not a new Pearson fit to each truncated lag vector. Independent explicit-pair fsum calculations agree with the NumPy benchmark within1.1102230246251565e-16, and the merged vs.gaps default399-draw seed408 result agrees with the independent calculation.

For o the observed mean over lags1–5 is -0.014750965122495643 in ZL and -0.011830306507526851 in Takahashi. These raw coefficients are negative; the reported effect is their excess over more-negative intact-word nulls, not positive raw autocorrelation.

With intact-word shuffling inside each original run and999 permutations at seeds408,19026011,28027, ZL p-values are0.009,0.012,0.012 and Takahashi p-values0.004,0.003,0.007. No seed was selected or threshold retuned. The paired editions read the same pages and these seed repetitions reuse the same observation.

The independently declared line-word null preserves each retained line's complete words, multiplicities and total character length, and preserves line/run/page order. Its corresponding p-values are0.032,0.034,0.045 in ZL and0.004,0.005,0.007 in Takahashi. Thus the tested effect is not removed simply by preserving the line-specific word stock, although ZL is closer to the conventional threshold.

On32 independently shuffled word-null books per edition, the same99-draw primary procedure rejects0/32 in ZL and2/32 in Takahashi at p<=0.05. This small finite calibration is not a population error guarantee; the editions and layouts are paired.

All27 published synthetic scenarios,64 books each (1728 books), match every reported numerical summary with the documented original source recipe. The nine base-rate0.160 scenarios use seed19026011. The o-rate0.124 and r-rate0.036 sensitivities use seeds19046011 and19056011 from rate_sensitivity.py. The initial wrapper audit omitted those offsets; original outputs were archived and no seed search was performed. Only the18 affected cases were rerun. The source generator and measurement code remain hash-identical to the author's bench.py.

At rate0.124, independent page-rate shifts produce64/64 long-band rejections under a global null and2/64 with page centering/page-count conditioning. Independent paragraph-rate shifts give40/64 rejections under the page-count null but3/64 when paragraph counts are fixed on the same page statistic. Unconditioned pooled correlation is therefore not sufficient evidence of gap-order dependence.

At rate0.036 and explicit lag20 gap-copy probability0.30, the point-lag test detects64/64 books with page pairs and paragraph-count conditioning, versus42/64 with within-run pairs. The broad11–40 mean detects only7/64 and3/64 respectively. The statistics have different sensitivity and cannot substitute for each other.

For observed r lag20, word-null p-values change from0.01/0.04 with page pairs to0.28/0.33 with within-run pairs, while eligible pairs fall from445/444 to55/57 (ZL/Takahashi). This supports caution about pair support and power, not a conclusion that all long-gap recurrence is absent.
limitations: The effect is descriptive on the public practice sample. It has not been scored on hidden pages and does not establish language, meaning, decipherment or a physical glyph inventory.
ZL and Takahashi are paired transcriptions of the same pages, not two independent manuscripts. Monte Carlo seeds and null books are robustness/calibration repeats on shared layouts.

The symbol, short band and statistic were inherited from earlier public exploration. The new line-word control and RNG checks were declared before their outcomes. This is an audit and sensitivity check, not a discovery corrected over all symbols and lag bands.

Whole-word nulls preserve internal spelling and local word stocks but alter word order. A residual can be produced by mechanical ordering rules or other local constraints; it does not identify a linguistic mechanism.
Some ZL line-null estimates are near0.05, with finite Monte Carlo uncertainty. Pair counts overlap within runs and should not be treated as independent observations.

The first execution used the base seed at all rates. A source-derived amendment followed the original README/rate_sensitivity wrapper; the initial raw draws remain archived with hashes. A separate metadata-only amendment normalized tuple/list representation. Neither changed the real-text measurement, original benchmark scoring, null, band or permutation count.

No trusted fact-DSL primitive for this conditional gap statistic/word null is currently exposed by the existing public-only command. Submitting a hidden-page fact before that integration would be invalid; this contribution is kind step.

plan.metric: For each run, count raw EVA positions in the space-joined word sequence, derive consecutive-hit differences, and center by the mean of all gaps in that run. At lag h retain a run only if number of gaps > h+1. Pool crossproducts and squared centered endpoints across runs; divide pooled crossproduct by sqrt(pooled squared endpoints). Require at least 25 eligible pairs for a lag. Average lags1..5 defined in the observed and all null draws.

"""Recheck saved synthetic data after JSON tuple/list metadata normalization.

No simulation or measurement is rerun or changed by this script.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import run_calibration as driver

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
expected = json.loads((ROOT/'expected-calibration.json').read_bytes())

scripts.run_calibration.py:
"""Reproduce every published conditional-hit calibration case, three workers."""
import hashlib
import argparse
import json
import math
import multiprocessing
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

import bench
from vs import corpus

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASES = [(rate, index) for rate in (.160, .124, .036) for index in range(9)]
RATE_KEYS = {.160: 'rate_0_160_primary', .124: 'rate_0_124_sensitivity', .036: 'rate_0_036_sensitivity'}


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def layout():
    pages = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[1] for e in ('zl', 'it')}
    retained = bench.line_ids(pages['zl']) & bench.line_ids(pages['it'])
    return bench.template(bench.layout(pages['zl'], retained))


def wilson(k, n):
    z = 1.959963984540054
    p = k/n
    denominator = 1+z*z/n
    midpoint = (p+z*z/(2*n))/denominator
    radius = z*math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/denominator
    return [round(midpoint-radius, 4), round(midpoint+radius, 4)]


def summarize(raw):
    cases = raw['replicates']
    keys = sorted({key for row in cases for key in row['scores']})
    result = {'regime': list(raw['regime']), 'books': len(cases), 'eligible_character_slots': raw['total_slots'],
              'median_hit_rate': round(median(row['hit_count']/raw['total_slots'] for row in cases), 5), 'tests': {}}
    for key in keys:
        rows = [row['scores'][key] for row in cases if key in row['scores']]
        k = sum(r['p'] <= .05 for r in rows)
        record = {'total_books': len(cases), 'eligible_books': len(rows), 'rejections': k,
                  'rejection_fraction': round(k/len(rows), 4), 'wilson_95': wilson(k, len(rows)),
                  'median_observed': round(median(r['observed'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_null_mean': round(median(r['null_mean'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_excess': round(median(r['observed']-r['null_mean'] for r in rows), 6),
                  'median_supported_lags': median(r['lags'] for r in rows),
                  'median_pairs_summed_over_lags': median(sum(r['pairs_by_lag'].values()) for r in rows)}
        band = key.split('/')[-1]
        important = (1,) if band == 'short_1_5' else (20,) if band == 'lag_20' else (20, 40)
        for lag in important:
            supported = [r['pairs_by_lag'][str(lag)] for r in rows if str(lag) in r['pairs_by_lag']]
            record[f'books_supporting_lag_{lag}'] = len(supported)
            record[f'median_pairs_lag_{lag}'] = median(supported) if supported else None
        result['tests'][key] = record
    return result


def run_case(case):
    rate, index = case
    bench.BASE_RATE = rate
    # Published rate_sensitivity.py uses distinct, documented seed offsets.
    bench.SEED = 19026011 + {.160: 0, .124: 20000, .036: 30000}[rate]
    raw = bench.run_scenario(index, layout(), 64, 99)
    filename = f'calibration-{rate:.3f}-{index}.json'
    payload = (json.dumps(raw, sort_keys=True)+'\n').encode()
    (ROOT/filename).write_bytes(payload)
    return {'rate': rate, 'index': index, 'raw_file': filename,
            'raw_sha256': hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), 'summary': summarize(raw)}


def differences(actual, expected, path=''):
    errors = []
    if isinstance(actual, dict) and isinstance(expected, dict):
        if actual.keys() != expected.keys():
            return [path+': keys '+str(actual.keys()-expected.keys())+' / '+str(expected.keys()-actual.keys())]
        for key in actual:
            errors += differences(actual[key], expected[key], path+'/'+key)
    elif isinstance(actual, list) and isinstance(expected, list):
        if len(actual) != len(expected):
            return [path+': length']
        for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected)):
            errors += differences(a, b, path+'/'+str(i))
    elif isinstance(actual, (int, float)) and isinstance(expected, (int, float)):
        if not math.isclose(actual, expected, abs_tol=1e-10, rel_tol=1e-10):
            errors.append(path+': '+repr(actual)+' != '+repr(expected))
    elif actual != expected:
        errors.append(path+': '+repr(actual)+' != '+repr(expected))
    return errors


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--sensitivity-only', action='store_true')
    sensitivity_only = parser.parse_args().sensitivity_only
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'bench.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '7fdadf75a4790f458be50373a69afbbd48ed6409c3729114e709b8eaa318d12a'
    expected = json.loads((ROOT/'expected-calibration.json').read_bytes())
    outputs = []
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=3, mp_context=multiprocessing.get_context('spawn')) as executor:
        jobs = {executor.submit(run_case, case): case for case in CASES if not sensitivity_only or case[0] != .160}
        for future in as_completed(jobs):
            result = future.result()
            name = RATE_KEYS[result['rate']]
            reference = next(row for row in expected[name] if row['regime'][0] == result['summary']['regime'][0])
            result['published_differences'] = differences(result['summary'], reference)
            outputs.append(result)
            print(result['rate'], result['index'], 'published differences', len(result['published_differences']), flush=True)
    outputs.sort(key=lambda r: (r['rate'], r['index']))
    final = {'cases': outputs, 'all_27_summary_objects_match': len(outputs) == 27 and all(not x['published_differences'] for x in outputs),
             'total_simulated_books': len(outputs)*64, 'permutations_per_test': 99}
    output_name = 'calibration-sensitivity-audit.json' if sensitivity_only else 'calibration-audit.json'
    (ROOT/output_name).write_bytes((json.dumps(final, indent=2)+'\n').encode())
    print('ALL MATCH', final['all_27_summary_objects_match'], flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
scripts.summarize.py:
import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
from math import sqrt
from pathlib import Path
import json
from statistics import median

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def wilson(successes, total):
    z = 1.959963984540054
    p = successes / total
    denominator = 1 + z*z/total
    center = (p + z*z/(2*total)) / denominator
    radius = z * sqrt(p*(1-p)/total + z*z/(4*total*total)) / denominator
    return [round(max(0, center - radius), 4), round(min(1, center + radius), 4)]


def summary(book):
    eligible = defaultdict(list)
    for replicate in book['replicates']:
        for test, record in replicate['scores'].items():
            eligible[test].append(record)
    result = {}
    for test, records in sorted(eligible.items()):
        rejects = sum(r['p'] <= .05 for r in records)
        result[test] = {
            'rejections': rejects,
            'eligible_books': len(records),
            'total_books': len(book['replicates']),
            'rejection_fraction': round(rejects/len(records), 4),
            'wilson_95': wilson(rejects, len(records)),
            'median_observed': round(median(r['observed'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_null_mean': round(median(r['null_mean'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_excess': round(median(r['observed'] - r['null_mean'] for r in records), 6),
            'median_supported_lags': median(r['lags'] for r in records),
            'median_pairs_summed_over_lags': median(sum(r['pairs_by_lag'].values()) for r in records),
        }
        for lag in ('1', '20', '40'):
            available = [r['pairs_by_lag'][lag] for r in records if lag in r['pairs_by_lag']]
            if available:
                result[test]['books_supporting_lag_' + lag] = len(available)
                result[test]['median_pairs_lag_' + lag] = median(available)
    return {'regime':book['regime'], 'eligible_character_slots':book['total_slots'],
            'books':len(book['replicates']), 'median_hit_rate':round(median(r['hit_count']/book['total_slots'] for r in book['replicates']),5),
            'tests':result}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path, default=ROOT, nargs="?")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    files = [args.directory / f'scenario-{i}.json' for i in range(9)]
    books = [summary(json.loads(file.read_text())) for file in files]
    print(json.dumps(books, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

detail.masked_method: A separate preparer recreated the prior crop and cover rectangles, placed adjacent views side by side, and randomly ordered the same 13 renderings for each reader in fresh isolated contexts. Readers received only numbered images and the rubric, without specimen names, provenance, or predicted correspondences. Some residual text could remain outside the masked header areas, and recognizable drawings could cue identity. The comparison paired scores by the matching masked PNG hashes before revealing the manuscript mapping. Consensus requires identical definite reader marks, and otherwise retains an unknown. native_scan_audit.09: The Glandes is a short isolated marginal sprig with a cup. The wide root spread on the same sheet belongs to a separate plant, so the 11 unresolved calls cannot be lifted by including its roots.
native_scan_audit.10: Egerton Galla shows offset rounded-lobed lower blades below the upper foliage and a visible basal junction. The roots fan downward and lack the f35v horizontal imbalance. Some narrow terminals are faint.
native_scan_audit.11: The Egerton Ebulus does have a visible spread below its stalk. Its faint continuations into the parchment make terminal curvature and maximal reach uncertain.
native_scan_audit.12: Egerton Brionia has a large downward fork with both ends at the lower sheet edge. Native coverage leaves the contour terminals unresolved.
native_scan_audit.13: The exposed basal line of Egerton ivy tapers to a point above its caption. A faint nearby mark does not establish a continuous root junction or a measurable root spread.

detail.rubric:
Use only visible outlines. Color may locate a contour but adds no point. For each criterion record 1 when visible, 0 when clearly absent or discordant on a complete view, and ? when genuinely ambiguous or cropped. Record all 12 criteria across the whole card. Do not name plants or guess provenance.

Fruit (F)
F1. At least two discrete clusters of three or more rounded enclosed units, counting each unit once; scattered solitary fruits do not count.
F2. At least one such cluster terminates a distinct stalk, with recognizable grouping and no enclosing common fruit body or backing leaf.
F3. No acorn-like cup, enclosing husk, or lobed capsule around the rounded units; mark unknown if outlines are unreadable, zero if no rounded units.

Leaf (L)
L1. At least two individually outlined side leaves attach at distinct levels below the top foliage.
L2. Those side leaves are simple and visibly lobed, with at least two broad rounded lobes per side.
L3. The strongest lobing repeats along the long axis on both sides of the leaf; do not count a three- to five-point palmate leaf, a smooth small leaf, or individual leaflets along a rachis.

Crown/stems (C)
C1. A compact upper foliage outline distinguishable from lower lateral leaves or fruit.
C2. Multiple upward stalks fan toward that upper outline from a relatively narrow common point or band.
C3. Two lower lateral stems visibly cross in front of or around a distinct upright axis; a single fork without crossing does not count.

Roots (R)
R1. Clearly drawn roots and aerial stems meet at a common basal junction.
R2. Major lateral roots or primary branches bear at least three recognizable hooked or curved tips in aggregate.
R3. Strongly asymmetric lateral spread, roughly 2:1 or greater from the stem center measured against opposite side, with the longest root roughly horizontal for much of its run.

step.json.rubric:
Use only visible outlines. Color may locate a contour but adds no point. For each criterion record 1 when visible, 0 when clearly absent or discordant on a complete view, and ? when genuinely ambiguous or cropped. Record all 12 criteria across the whole card. Do not name plants or guess provenance.

Fruit (F)
F1. At least two discrete clusters of three or more rounded enclosed units, counting each unit once; scattered solitary fruits do not count.
F2. At least one such cluster terminates a distinct stalk, with recognizable grouping and no enclosing common fruit body or backing leaf.
F3. No acorn-like cup, enclosing husk, or lobed capsule around the rounded units; mark unknown if outlines are unreadable, zero if no rounded units.

Leaf (L)
L1. At least two individually outlined side leaves attach at distinct levels below the top foliage.
L2. Those side leaves are simple and visibly lobed, with at least two broad rounded lobes per side.
L3. The strongest lobing repeats along the long axis on both sides of the leaf; do not count a three- to five-point palmate leaf, a smooth small leaf, or individual leaflets along a rachis.

Crown/stems (C)
C1. A compact upper foliage outline distinguishable from lower lateral leaves or fruit.
C2. Multiple upward stalks fan toward that upper outline from a relatively narrow common point or band.
C3. Two lower lateral stems visibly cross in front of or around a distinct upright axis; a single fork without crossing does not count.

Roots (R)
R1. Clearly drawn roots and aerial stems meet at a common basal junction.
R2. Major lateral roots or primary branches bear at least three recognizable hooked or curved tips in aggregate.
R3. Strongly asymmetric lateral spread, roughly 2:1 or greater from the stem center measured against opposite side, with the longest root roughly horizontal for much of its run.

established: In 3,884 P0 lines, adjacent words were identical in 0.957% of within-line opportunities and 0.194% of opportunities across successive lines on the same folio. The author reports p=0.0002 under a folio-preserving shuffle. Alternative transcriptions are measurements of the same manuscript.

At a matched history length of 640 tokens, bifolio caches gained 0.020, 0.028, and 0.021 bits per token relative to folio caches in the H, C, and F transcriptions. Whole bifolios are the held-out groups in the model comparisons. Nominal gains from unequal history lengths combine physical scope and amount of context.

The H/80-token direct morphology contrast has 46 eligible physical pairs, then 32 exact-distance pairs in 12 quires, then 22 pairs in nine quires after additionally matching hand, Currier class and illustration domain. The last comparison retains a negative mate-minus-control distance of about -0.00857, with p=0.120987901. The complete-metadata sensitivity has 17 pairs in seven quires and p=0.101389861. The stricter text-only test does not establish a separate association.

An analysis of pixels and anonymous word boxes independent of token strings finds stronger mate similarity in measured production features for 41 Voyager and 38 Yale bifolios with both leaves represented. Each conditional p=0.0002 uses random rematching within the quire without exact matching by folio distance, hand, Currier class and domain. The two scans show the same manuscript and share the underlying box coordinate inventory. Registration succeeds on 176/176 eligible Voyager sides and 143/181 eligible Yale sides. The Yale sensitivity requiring two sides per leaf has only 18 complete mates.

At each of five stated widths from 2,810 to 8,430 tokens, the observed H transcription block-variance exponent exceeds all 256 samples from the reference generator. All 16 calibration works exceed the median of both their frequency-preserving shuffle and empirical-bigram controls at every width. The author reports that H exceeds the external calibration range at the primary width and that the widest window leaves only three complete blocks.

The archived inventories contain zero comparable chemical main-text mate pairs. One usable multispectral mate pair, f1r and f8r, ranks seventh by distance among 28 image pairs in the primary 12-band analysis and from seventh to sixteenth in the sensitivity analyses. These public data leave the material explanation unresolved.

"""Metadata-only independent physical-support audit; run from repository root."""
import json, re, hashlib
from collections import Counter
from functools import lru_cache
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path
from vs import corpus, ivtff

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = Path.cwd()

def collect(part, minimum=40):
    editions = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[part] for e in ('zl','it')}
    it = {p.id:p for p in editions['it']}
    order = list(dict.fromkeys(re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0] for p in corpus.pages('zl')))
    rows = []
    for p in editions['zl']:
        q = it.get(p.id)
        if q is None or (p.hand,p.section,p.language)!=(q.hand,q.section,q.language): continue
        lengths = [sum(not ivtff.uncertain(w) for ln in x.lines if ln.unit=='P' for w in ln.words) for x in (p,q)]
        if min(lengths)<minimum or not p.hand or not p.section: continue
        folio = re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0]
        rows.append(dict(id=p.id,folio=folio,order=order.index(folio),number=int(folio[1:]),hand=p.hand,
                         section=p.section,language=p.language,lengths=lengths,quire=p.meta.get('Q'),
                         bifolio=p.meta.get('B'),physical=(p.meta.get('Q','?')+':'+p.meta.get('B','?'))))
    return rows

def pack(sets):
    sets = tuple(sorted({tuple(sorted(s)) for s in sets}))
    @lru_cache(None)
    def solve(i,used):
        if i==len(sets): return ()
        best=solve(i+1,used)
        if not set(sets[i]) & set(used):
            candidate=(sets[i],)+solve(i+1,tuple(sorted(set(used)|set(sets[i]))))
            if len(candidate)>len(best): best=candidate
        return best
    return solve(0,())

def support(edges):
    pages={p['id']:p for edge in edges for p in edge}
    return dict(comparisons=len(edges),page_sides=len(pages),folios=len({p['folio'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia_per_comparison=dict(Counter(len({p['physical'] for p in edge}) for edge in edges)),
                max_bifolio_disjoint=len(pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                max_quire_disjoint=len(pack([{p['quire'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                witnesses=pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges]))

def match(a,b,distance,ratio):
    return (a['section']==b['section'] and 0<abs(a['order']-b['order'])<=distance
            and all(max(x,y)/min(x,y)<=ratio for x,y in zip(a['lengths'],b['lengths'])))

def main():
    train,test=collect(0),collect(1)
    eligible=lambda rows:[p for p in rows if p['section']=='H' and p['language']=='B' and p['hand'] in ('2','3','5')]
    tr,ev=eligible(train),eligible(test)
    independent={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('local',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        raw=[(a,b) for a,b in combinations(ev,2) if a['hand']!=b['hand'] and match(a,b,dist,ratio)]
        details=[]
        for a,b in raw:
            fit=[p for p in tr if p['quire'] not in (a['quire'],b['quire'])]

def collect(part, minimum=40):
    editions = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[part] for e in ('zl','it')}
    it = {p.id:p for p in editions['it']}
    order = list(dict.fromkeys(re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0] for p in corpus.pages('zl')))
    rows = []
    for p in editions['zl']:
        q = it.get(p.id)
        if q is None or (p.hand,p.section,p.language)!=(q.hand,q.section,q.language): continue
        lengths = [sum(not ivtff.uncertain(w) for ln in x.lines if ln.unit=='P' for w in ln.words) for x in (p,q)]
        if min(lengths)<minimum or not p.hand or not p.section: continue
        folio = re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0]
        rows.append(dict(id=p.id,folio=folio,order=order.index(folio),number=int(folio[1:]),hand=p.hand,
                         section=p.section,language=p.language,lengths=lengths,quire=p.meta.get('Q'),
                         bifolio=p.meta.get('B'),physical=(p.meta.get('Q','?')+':'+p.meta.get('B','?'))))
    return rows

def pack(sets):
    sets = tuple(sorted({tuple(sorted(s)) for s in sets}))
    @lru_cache(None)
    def solve(i,used):
        if i==len(sets): return ()
        best=solve(i+1,used)
        if not set(sets[i]) & set(used):
            candidate=(sets[i],)+solve(i+1,tuple(sorted(set(used)|set(sets[i]))))
            if len(candidate)>len(best): best=candidate
        return best
    return solve(0,())

method: Select eligible pages from ZL public practice training only. Reproduce the published sample from seed 408, reserve 124 pages for layout, and learn a new implementation of the fixed two/four-glyph transition tables on the remaining 68 pages. The original executable was unavailable. The reconstruction has ordinary and opener starts and 25% whole-word reuse for familiar words in a rolling memory of 300, with no mutation or moving training window.

"""Check whether cyclic rotation changes section entropy before any words are generated."""

from collections import Counter
import json
from math import log2

from calibrate_sections import prepare


def entropy(counts):
    total = sum(counts.values())
    return -sum((value / total) * log2(value / total) for value in counts.values() if value)


def describe(layout):
    counts = Counter(page for page, _, line, _ in layout.items if line.unit == "P")
    labels = layout.page_labels
    assignments = []
    for shift in range(len(labels)):
        grouped = Counter()
        for page, count in counts.items():
            grouped[labels[(page - shift) % len(labels)]] += count
        assignments.append(grouped)
    entropies = [entropy(grouped) for grouped in assignments]
    observed = entropies[0]
    return {
        "size": layout.size,
        "order": layout.order,
        "section_paragraph_line_counts": dict(assignments[0]),
        "observed_section_entropy_bits": round(observed, 6),
        "unshifted_entropy_rank": sum(value >= observed - 1e-11 for value in entropies),
        "largest_entropy_bits": round(max(entropies), 6),
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    layouts, _, _ = prepare()
    print(json.dumps([describe(layout) for layout in layouts], indent=2))

"""Metadata-only independent physical-support audit; run from repository root."""
import json, re, hashlib
from collections import Counter
from functools import lru_cache
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path
from vs import corpus, ivtff

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = Path.cwd()

def collect(part, minimum=40):
    editions = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[part] for e in ('zl','it')}
    it = {p.id:p for p in editions['it']}
    order = list(dict.fromkeys(re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0] for p in corpus.pages('zl')))
    rows = []
    for p in editions['zl']:
        q = it.get(p.id)
        if q is None or (p.hand,p.section,p.language)!=(q.hand,q.section,q.language): continue
        lengths = [sum(not ivtff.uncertain(w) for ln in x.lines if ln.unit=='P' for w in ln.words) for x in (p,q)]
        if min(lengths)<minimum or not p.hand or not p.section: continue
        folio = re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0]
        rows.append(dict(id=p.id,folio=folio,order=order.index(folio),number=int(folio[1:]),hand=p.hand,
                         section=p.section,language=p.language,lengths=lengths,quire=p.meta.get('Q'),
                         bifolio=p.meta.get('B'),physical=(p.meta.get('Q','?')+':'+p.meta.get('B','?'))))
    return rows

def pack(sets):
    sets = tuple(sorted({tuple(sorted(s)) for s in sets}))
    @lru_cache(None)
    def solve(i,used):
        if i==len(sets): return ()
        best=solve(i+1,used)
        if not set(sets[i]) & set(used):
            candidate=(sets[i],)+solve(i+1,tuple(sorted(set(used)|set(sets[i]))))
            if len(candidate)>len(best): best=candidate
        return best
    return solve(0,())

def support(edges):
    pages={p['id']:p for edge in edges for p in edge}
    return dict(comparisons=len(edges),page_sides=len(pages),folios=len({p['folio'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia_per_comparison=dict(Counter(len({p['physical'] for p in edge}) for edge in edges)),
                max_bifolio_disjoint=len(pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                max_quire_disjoint=len(pack([{p['quire'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                witnesses=pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges]))

def match(a,b,distance,ratio):
    return (a['section']==b['section'] and 0<abs(a['order']-b['order'])<=distance
            and all(max(x,y)/min(x,y)<=ratio for x,y in zip(a['lengths'],b['lengths'])))

def main():
    train,test=collect(0),collect(1)
    eligible=lambda rows:[p for p in rows if p['section']=='H' and p['language']=='B' and p['hand'] in ('2','3','5')]
    tr,ev=eligible(train),eligible(test)
    independent={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('local',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        raw=[(a,b) for a,b in combinations(ev,2) if a['hand']!=b['hand'] and match(a,b,dist,ratio)]
        details=[]
        for a,b in raw:
            fit=[p for p in tr if p['quire'] not in (a['quire'],b['quire'])]
            counts={h:len({p['folio'] for p in fit if p['hand']==h}) for h in ('2','5')}
            details.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],bifolia=[a['physical'],b['physical']],training_folios=counts))
        good=[edge for edge,d in zip(raw,details) if min(d['training_folios'].values())>=2]
        independent[name]=dict(raw=support(raw),trainable=support(good),details=details)
    # Reconstruct the original four-folio modulo-four test folds and both Currier-matched rules.
    prior={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('strict',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        edges=[]; overlap=[]; clean_training=[]
        for fold in range(4):
            fit=[p for p in train if (p['order']//4)%4!=fold]
            held=[p for p in train if (p['order']//4)%4==fold]
            for a,b in combinations(held,2):
                if a['hand']==b['hand'] or min(sum(p['hand']==h for p in fit) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand']))<2: continue
                if a['language']!=b['language'] or not match(a,b,dist,ratio): continue
                edges.append((a,b))
                shared={a['physical'],b['physical']} & {p['physical'] for p in fit}
                if shared: overlap.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],shared=sorted(shared)))
                clean=[p for p in fit if p['physical'] not in (a['physical'],b['physical'])]
                clean_training.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],folios_by_hand={h:len({p['folio'] for p in clean if p['hand']==h}) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand'])},bifolia_by_hand={h:sorted({p['physical'] for p in clean if p['hand']==h}) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand'])}))
        prior[name]=dict(support=support(edges),pairs=[[a['id'],b['id']] for a,b in edges],training_overlap=overlap,
                         bifolio_excluded_training=clean_training)
    # Reconstruct prior same-Currier triads under its original numeric-folio 16-leaf blocks.
    tri_docs=collect(0,50); triads=[]; grouped={}
    for a in tri_docs:
        for b in tri_docs:
            for c in tri_docs:
                if len({a['folio'],b['folio'],c['folio']})!=3: continue
                if len({(x['number']-1)//16 for x in (a,b,c)})!=1: continue
                if a['hand']!=b['hand'] or a['hand']==c['hand']: continue
                if len({x['section'] for x in (a,b,c)})!=1 or len({x['language'] for x in (a,b,c)})!=1: continue
                da,dc=abs(a['number']-b['number']),abs(a['number']-c['number'])
                if max(da,dc)>12 or abs(da-dc)>2: continue
                if any(max(x['lengths'][j] for x in (a,b,c))/min(x['lengths'][j] for x in (a,b,c))>1.25 for j in (0,1)): continue
                triads.append((a,b,c));grouped.setdefault(str((a['number']-1)//16),[]).append((a,b,c))
    expected_pairs=json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/K-030-open-1/fleet-sol/step.json').read_text())['practice']['totals']
    pair_counts_match=(prior['strict']['support']['comparisons']==expected_pairs['section and Currier and matched']['pairs']
                       and prior['wide']['support']['comparisons']==expected_pairs['section and Currier and wider match']['pairs'])
    assert pair_counts_match
    assert len(triads)==10
    result=dict(protocol=json.loads((OUT/'plan-independent.json').read_text()),prior_pair_counts_match=pair_counts_match,
                metadata_table_exact_match=json.loads((OUT/'layout-reproduced.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))==json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/P-L2-002/mubadala777/step.json').read_text())['metadata_results'],
                independent_evaluation=ev,independent=independent,prior_pairs=prior,
                prior_triads=dict(support=support(triads),blocks={k:support(v) for k,v in grouped.items()},
                                  rows=[[p['id'] for p in edge] for edge in triads]),
                inventory={h:dict(pages=[p['id'] for p in tr+ev if p['hand']==h],bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in tr+ev if p['hand']==h})) for h in ('2','3','5')},
                hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ('data/raw/ZL3b-n.txt','data/raw/IT2a-n.txt')})
    (OUT/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__': main()

"""Frozen public bifolio-exclusive diagnostics; all fit inputs are training-only."""
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from vs import corpus,generators
import control
import audit

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def baseline(train,test):
    a,b=control.documents(train,test)
    means=control.unit_rows(np.array([a[[str(p.hand)==h for p in train]].mean(axis=0) for h in ('2','5')]))
    cos=b@means.T
    return dict(margin=float(cos[0,0]+cos[1,1]-cos[0,1]-cos[1,0]),features=a.shape[1],
                zero_train_rows=int(sum(np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1)==0)),zero_test_rows=int(sum(np.linalg.norm(b,axis=1)==0)))

def main():
    tr=[p for p in audit.collect(0) if p['section']=='H' and p['language']=='B' and p['hand'] in ('2','5')]
    all_rows=audit.collect(0)+audit.collect(1); by={p['id']:p for p in all_rows}
    pairs=[['f55v','f57r'],['f46v','f48r'],['f46v','f48v'],['f50v','f41r'],['f50v','f66v']]
    result={'plan':json.loads((HERE/'plan.json').read_text()),'geometry':[],'scores':[], 'numpy':np.__version__}
    for ids in pairs:
        ids=sorted(ids,key=lambda x:by[x]['hand'])
        held={by[x]['physical'] for x in ids}
        fitted=[p for p in tr if p['physical'] not in held]
        counts={h:{'folios':len({p['folio'] for p in fitted if p['hand']==h}),
                   'bifolia':len({p['physical'] for p in fitted if p['hand']==h})} for h in ('2','5')}
        geom=dict(pages=ids,test_bifolia=sorted(held),train_ids=[p['id'] for p in fitted],counts=counts,
                  primary_eligible=all(c['bifolia']>=2 for c in counts.values()),
                  diagnostic_eligible=all(c['folios']>=2 for c in counts.values()))
        assert held.isdisjoint(p['physical'] for p in fitted)
        assert set(ids).isdisjoint(p['id'] for p in fitted)
        result['geometry'].append(geom)
        if not geom['diagnostic_eligible']: continue
        for edition in ('zl','it'):
            train,test=corpus.split_pages('practice',edition)
            index={p.id:p for p in train+test}
            train_layout=[control.eligible_page(index[p['id']]) for p in fitted]
            test_layout=[control.eligible_page(index[x]) for x in ids]
            pools=[('observed',None,train_layout+test_layout)]
            for seed in range(401,407):
                copied=generators.g_self_citation(train_layout,train_layout+test_layout,seed=seed)
                planted,_=control.plant_words(copied,seed)
                pools.extend([('copy',seed,copied),('planted',seed,planted)])
            for case,seed,pages in pools:
                n=len(train_layout);a,b=pages[:n],pages[n:]
                record=dict(pages=ids,edition=edition,scenario=case,generator_seed=seed,
                            tfidf=baseline(a,b),nmf={str(s):control.pair_margin(a,b,s) for s in (47,83,113)})
                result['scores'].append(record)
            print(ids,edition,'completed',flush=True)
    result['primary_eligible_pairs']=sum(x['primary_eligible'] for x in result['geometry'])
    result['diagnostic_pairs']=sum(x['diagnostic_eligible'] for x in result['geometry'])
    result['sha256']={n:hashlib.sha256((HERE/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ('plan.json','run.py','control.py','audit.py')}
    (HERE/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Metadata-only independent physical-support audit; run from repository root."""
import json, re, hashlib
from collections import Counter
from functools import lru_cache
from itertools import combinations
from pathlib import Path
from vs import corpus, ivtff

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = Path.cwd()

def collect(part, minimum=40):
    editions = {e: corpus.split_pages('practice', e)[part] for e in ('zl','it')}
    it = {p.id:p for p in editions['it']}
    order = list(dict.fromkeys(re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0] for p in corpus.pages('zl')))
    rows = []
    for p in editions['zl']:
        q = it.get(p.id)
        if q is None or (p.hand,p.section,p.language)!=(q.hand,q.section,q.language): continue
        lengths = [sum(not ivtff.uncertain(w) for ln in x.lines if ln.unit=='P' for w in ln.words) for x in (p,q)]
        if min(lengths)<minimum or not p.hand or not p.section: continue
        folio = re.match(r'f\d+',p.id)[0]
        rows.append(dict(id=p.id,folio=folio,order=order.index(folio),number=int(folio[1:]),hand=p.hand,
                         section=p.section,language=p.language,lengths=lengths,quire=p.meta.get('Q'),
                         bifolio=p.meta.get('B'),physical=(p.meta.get('Q','?')+':'+p.meta.get('B','?'))))
    return rows

def pack(sets):
    sets = tuple(sorted({tuple(sorted(s)) for s in sets}))
    @lru_cache(None)
    def solve(i,used):
        if i==len(sets): return ()
        best=solve(i+1,used)
        if not set(sets[i]) & set(used):
            candidate=(sets[i],)+solve(i+1,tuple(sorted(set(used)|set(sets[i]))))
            if len(candidate)>len(best): best=candidate
        return best
    return solve(0,())

def support(edges):
    pages={p['id']:p for edge in edges for p in edge}
    return dict(comparisons=len(edges),page_sides=len(pages),folios=len({p['folio'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in pages.values()}),
                bifolia_per_comparison=dict(Counter(len({p['physical'] for p in edge}) for edge in edges)),
                max_bifolio_disjoint=len(pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                max_quire_disjoint=len(pack([{p['quire'] for p in edge} for edge in edges])),
                witnesses=pack([{p['physical'] for p in edge} for edge in edges]))

def match(a,b,distance,ratio):
    return (a['section']==b['section'] and 0<abs(a['order']-b['order'])<=distance
            and all(max(x,y)/min(x,y)<=ratio for x,y in zip(a['lengths'],b['lengths'])))

def main():
    train,test=collect(0),collect(1)
    eligible=lambda rows:[p for p in rows if p['section']=='H' and p['language']=='B' and p['hand'] in ('2','3','5')]
    tr,ev=eligible(train),eligible(test)
    independent={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('local',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        raw=[(a,b) for a,b in combinations(ev,2) if a['hand']!=b['hand'] and match(a,b,dist,ratio)]
        details=[]
        for a,b in raw:
            fit=[p for p in tr if p['quire'] not in (a['quire'],b['quire'])]
            counts={h:len({p['folio'] for p in fit if p['hand']==h}) for h in ('2','5')}
            details.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],bifolia=[a['physical'],b['physical']],training_folios=counts))
        good=[edge for edge,d in zip(raw,details) if min(d['training_folios'].values())>=2]
        independent[name]=dict(raw=support(raw),trainable=support(good),details=details)
    # Reconstruct the original four-folio modulo-four test folds and both Currier-matched rules.
    prior={}
    for name,dist,ratio in [('strict',12,1.25),('wide',24,1.5)]:
        edges=[]; overlap=[]; clean_training=[]
        for fold in range(4):
            fit=[p for p in train if (p['order']//4)%4!=fold]
            held=[p for p in train if (p['order']//4)%4==fold]
            for a,b in combinations(held,2):
                if a['hand']==b['hand'] or min(sum(p['hand']==h for p in fit) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand']))<2: continue
                if a['language']!=b['language'] or not match(a,b,dist,ratio): continue
                edges.append((a,b))
                shared={a['physical'],b['physical']} & {p['physical'] for p in fit}
                if shared: overlap.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],shared=sorted(shared)))
                clean=[p for p in fit if p['physical'] not in (a['physical'],b['physical'])]
                clean_training.append(dict(pages=[a['id'],b['id']],folios_by_hand={h:len({p['folio'] for p in clean if p['hand']==h}) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand'])},bifolia_by_hand={h:sorted({p['physical'] for p in clean if p['hand']==h}) for h in (a['hand'],b['hand'])}))
        prior[name]=dict(support=support(edges),pairs=[[a['id'],b['id']] for a,b in edges],training_overlap=overlap,
                         bifolio_excluded_training=clean_training)
    # Reconstruct prior same-Currier triads under its original numeric-folio 16-leaf blocks.
    tri_docs=collect(0,50); triads=[]; grouped={}
    for a in tri_docs:
        for b in tri_docs:
            for c in tri_docs:
                if len({a['folio'],b['folio'],c['folio']})!=3: continue
                if len({(x['number']-1)//16 for x in (a,b,c)})!=1: continue
                if a['hand']!=b['hand'] or a['hand']==c['hand']: continue
                if len({x['section'] for x in (a,b,c)})!=1 or len({x['language'] for x in (a,b,c)})!=1: continue
                da,dc=abs(a['number']-b['number']),abs(a['number']-c['number'])
                if max(da,dc)>12 or abs(da-dc)>2: continue
                if any(max(x['lengths'][j] for x in (a,b,c))/min(x['lengths'][j] for x in (a,b,c))>1.25 for j in (0,1)): continue
                triads.append((a,b,c));grouped.setdefault(str((a['number']-1)//16),[]).append((a,b,c))
    expected_pairs=json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/K-030-open-1/fleet-sol/step.json').read_text())['practice']['totals']
    pair_counts_match=(prior['strict']['support']['comparisons']==expected_pairs['section and Currier and matched']['pairs']
                       and prior['wide']['support']['comparisons']==expected_pairs['section and Currier and wider match']['pairs'])
    assert pair_counts_match
    assert len(triads)==10
    result=dict(protocol=json.loads((OUT/'plan-independent.json').read_text()),prior_pair_counts_match=pair_counts_match,
                metadata_table_exact_match=json.loads((OUT/'layout-reproduced.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))==json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/P-L2-002/mubadala777/step.json').read_text())['metadata_results'],
                independent_evaluation=ev,independent=independent,prior_pairs=prior,
                prior_triads=dict(support=support(triads),blocks={k:support(v) for k,v in grouped.items()},
                                  rows=[[p['id'] for p in edge] for edge in triads]),
                inventory={h:dict(pages=[p['id'] for p in tr+ev if p['hand']==h],bifolia=sorted({p['physical'] for p in tr+ev if p['hand']==h})) for h in ('2','3','5')},
                hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ('data/raw/ZL3b-n.txt','data/raw/IT2a-n.txt')})
    (OUT/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__': main()

"""Frozen public bifolio-exclusive diagnostics; all fit inputs are training-only."""
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from vs import corpus,generators
import control
import audit

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def baseline(train,test):
    a,b=control.documents(train,test)
    means=control.unit_rows(np.array([a[[str(p.hand)==h for p in train]].mean(axis=0) for h in ('2','5')]))
    cos=b@means.T
    return dict(margin=float(cos[0,0]+cos[1,1]-cos[0,1]-cos[1,0]),features=a.shape[1],
                zero_train_rows=int(sum(np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1)==0)),zero_test_rows=int(sum(np.linalg.norm(b,axis=1)==0)))

def main():
    tr=[p for p in audit.collect(0) if p['section']=='H' and p['language']=='B' and p['hand'] in ('2','5')]
    all_rows=audit.collect(0)+audit.collect(1); by={p['id']:p for p in all_rows}
    pairs=[['f55v','f57r'],['f46v','f48r'],['f46v','f48v'],['f50v','f41r'],['f50v','f66v']]
    result={'plan':json.loads((HERE/'plan.json').read_text()),'geometry':[],'scores':[], 'numpy':np.__version__}
    for ids in pairs:
        ids=sorted(ids,key=lambda x:by[x]['hand'])
        held={by[x]['physical'] for x in ids}
        fitted=[p for p in tr if p['physical'] not in held]
        counts={h:{'folios':len({p['folio'] for p in fitted if p['hand']==h}),
                   'bifolia':len({p['physical'] for p in fitted if p['hand']==h})} for h in ('2','5')}
        geom=dict(pages=ids,test_bifolia=sorted(held),train_ids=[p['id'] for p in fitted],counts=counts,
                  primary_eligible=all(c['bifolia']>=2 for c in counts.values()),
                  diagnostic_eligible=all(c['folios']>=2 for c in counts.values()))
        assert held.isdisjoint(p['physical'] for p in fitted)
        assert set(ids).isdisjoint(p['id'] for p in fitted)
        result['geometry'].append(geom)
        if not geom['diagnostic_eligible']: continue
        for edition in ('zl','it'):
            train,test=corpus.split_pages('practice',edition)
            index={p.id:p for p in train+test}
            train_layout=[control.eligible_page(index[p['id']]) for p in fitted]
            test_layout=[control.eligible_page(index[x]) for x in ids]
            pools=[('observed',None,train_layout+test_layout)]
            for seed in range(401,407):
                copied=generators.g_self_citation(train_layout,train_layout+test_layout,seed=seed)
                planted,_=control.plant_words(copied,seed)
                pools.extend([('copy',seed,copied),('planted',seed,planted)])
            for case,seed,pages in pools:
                n=len(train_layout);a,b=pages[:n],pages[n:]
                record=dict(pages=ids,edition=edition,scenario=case,generator_seed=seed,
                            tfidf=baseline(a,b),nmf={str(s):control.pair_margin(a,b,s) for s in (47,83,113)})
                result['scores'].append(record)
            print(ids,edition,'completed',flush=True)
    result['primary_eligible_pairs']=sum(x['primary_eligible'] for x in result['geometry'])
    result['diagnostic_pairs']=sum(x['diagnostic_eligible'] for x in result['geometry'])
    result['sha256']={n:hashlib.sha256((HERE/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ('plan.json','run.py','control.py','audit.py')}
    (HERE/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

Compare mass-bin-conditioned cyclic rotations with block-aware replacements that preserve page sequences inside contiguous runs. Check false rejections and power with new stationary-table rolling-memory backgrounds, matched placebos, and multiple fixed layouts at the same page count.

detail.check: Freeze a comparison that conditions both eligible paragraph token mass and local text dependence. Compare mass-bin-conditioned cyclic rotations with block-aware replacements that preserve page sequences inside contiguous runs. Declare attainable-rank support before computing statistics, and keep unmatched results as abstentions. Check false rejections and power with new stationary-table rolling-memory backgrounds, matched placebos, and multiple fixed layouts at the same page count.
method: Reuse the frozen public training-page reservation and stationary transition tables with rolling word memory. Use one shared generated line stream with an independent opener-style draw. At each fixed page count preserve the page set and compare the manuscript order and two newly seeded page shuffles. The observed selection of paragraph slots is held fixed.

For Null A, group pages by exactly equal selected paragraph word counts and uniformly permute labels only inside each group. Eligible section token totals and section page counts stay exactly equal. For Null B, sort pages by selected paragraph counts and folio identity and form consecutive groups of eight, retaining the final shorter block. Propose independent uniform label permutations inside groups and retain only assignments with the same global vector of integer percentage bins: floor(100 times section words divided by total selected words). The bins are anchored at zero and the label counts within each group are fixed. This admits fewer than one percentage point of change for each section and can still mean a substantial relative difference for a small section.

Enumerate the ambient assignments exactly when there are at most 12,000, and otherwise inspect up to 12,000 uniform proposals. Keep up to 199 distinct nonidentity assignments, with a uniform subset when enumerated support is larger. Report exact conditioned support when known and retained support otherwise. Count ties conservatively, include the identity in the denominator and require at least 19 or 99 alternatives for the two alpha levels.

For each background use the same assignments for the unplanted text and the four original doses of length-preserving plant and placebo. A placebo retains the chosen positions, original lengths and multiset of markers within each length group. Compare against the 199 all-token shuffles, 199 intact-page label shuffles, and all cyclic offsets from P-J-017.

Conditional randomization presumes exchangeable assignments given the declared strata and mass bins. It does not preserve local dependence or section runs. Some outcomes are cap-limited rather than proven to have small exact support. Conditional rejection denominators omit abstentions and are never treated as 20 when a design is unsupported. The layouts and interventions reuse paired backgrounds, so counts across layouts are not independent.

plan.notes: Use a uniform permutation of labels within each frozen block. Condition approximate draws on the full vector of fixed bins, not a distance around the current observed count.

"""Summarize size-conditioned power and eligibility at 5% and 1%."""

from collections import defaultdict
import json
from math import sqrt
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ORDER = ["manuscript", "shuffle-49311", "shuffle-69329"]
NULLS = ["token", "page", "cyclic", "exact token mass", "one-percentage-point bins"]


def records():
    data = [
        json.loads(line)
        for file in ("pilot.jsonl", "remaining.jsonl")
        for line in (ROOT / file).read_text().splitlines()
    ]
    cases = [row for item in data for row in item["cases"]]
    support = [row for item in data for row in item["support"]]
    assert len(data) == 20 and len(cases) == 1620 and len(support) == 180
    assert len({tuple(row[:5]) for row in cases}) == len(cases)
    assert all(row[3]["largest_section_word_count_shift"] == 0 for row in support)
    return cases, support


def wilson(hits, n):
    if not n:
        return None
    z = 1.959964
    p = hits / n
    d = 1 + z*z/n
    center = (p + z*z/(2*n))/d
    half = z*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + z*z/(4*n*n))/d
    return [round(max(0, center-half), 4), round(min(1, center+half), 4)]


def summarize(cases):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in cases:
        groups[tuple(row[1:5])].append(row)
    summary = []
    for design, rows in sorted(groups.items()):
        size, _, _, _ = design
        by_test = []
        for index, test in enumerate(NULLS):
            ranks = [row[6 + index] for row in rows]
            denominators = [([200, 200, size, row[11]+1, row[12]+1][index]) for row in rows]
            results = [test, [min(denominators), median(denominators), max(denominators)]]
            for cutoff in (20, 100):
                can_reject = sum(m >= cutoff for m in denominators)
                rejects = sum(rank * cutoff <= m for rank, m in zip(ranks, denominators, strict=True))
                results.append([can_reject, rejects, wilson(rejects, can_reject)])
            by_test.append(results)
        summary.append({"design": design, "tests": by_test})
    return summary


def compact_cases(cases):
    return [
        [seed, size, ORDER.index(order), ("base", "plant", "placebo").index(case), dose, *observations]
        for seed, size, order, case, dose, *observations in cases
    ]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cases, _ = records()
    (ROOT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summarize(cases), indent=2) + "\n")

The calibration retains abstentions separately from nonrejections and compares both 0.05 and 0.01 thresholds.

            for cutoff in (20, 100):
                can_reject = sum(m >= cutoff for m in denominators)
                rejects = sum(rank * cutoff <= m for rank, m in zip(ranks, denominators, strict=True))
                results.append([can_reject, rejects, wilson(rejects, can_reject)])
            by_test.append(results)
        summary.append({"design": design, "tests": by_test})
    return summary


def compact_cases(cases):
    return [
        [seed, size, ORDER.index(order), ("base", "plant", "placebo").index(case), dose, *observations]
        for seed, size, order, case, dose, *observations in cases
    ]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cases, _ = records()
    (ROOT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summarize(cases), indent=2) + "\n")

The exact-mass test cannot attain alpha 0.05 in any of the 60 backgrounds at 31 pages. At 124 pages in the two fresh shuffled orders, cyclic testing rejected 18/20 and 13/20 unplanted samples. Matching eligible token masses therefore helps on these shuffled orders but does not remove the spurious section signal on manuscript-order backgrounds with local word memory. The calibration retains abstentions separately from nonrejections and compares both 0.05 and 0.01 thresholds.

"""Post-primary descriptive full-word profiles, with independent arithmetic checks."""
import json,math
from pathlib import Path
import run

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def main():
    v=run.vector(['aa','ab'],'chars')
    assert abs(v['a']-3/math.sqrt(10))<1e-12
    assert abs(v['b']-1/math.sqrt(10))<1e-12
    b=run.vector(['aa','ab'],'bigrams')
    assert abs(b['aa']-1/math.sqrt(2))<1e-12
    assert abs(run.cosine(v,v)-1)<1e-12
    pages,meta=run.collect();result={'plan':json.loads((HERE/'sensitivity-plan.json').read_text()),'scores':[]}
    for e,layout in pages.items():
        words=run.groups(layout)
        refs=[b for b in words if meta[b]['section']=='S']
        herbs=[b for b in words if meta[b]['section']=='H']
        target=next(b for b in herbs if meta[b]['hand']=='3')
        for feature in ('chars','bigrams','words'):
            vs={b:run.vector(w,feature) for b,w in words.items()}
            c=run.centroid([vs[b] for b in refs])
            sims={b:run.cosine(vs[b],c) for b in herbs}
            rank=1+sum(x>sims[target]+1e-12 for b,x in sims.items() if b!=target)+.5*sum(abs(x-sims[target])<=1e-12 for b,x in sims.items() if b!=target)
            controls=[x for b,x in sims.items() if b!=target]
            result['scores'].append(dict(edition=e,feature=feature,rank=rank,similarities=sims,
                                         target_minus_mean_control=sims[target]-sum(controls)/len(controls)))
    (HERE/'sensitivity.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(result['scores'],indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
