    return [(i+(i//skip if skip else 0))%rows for i in range(n)]

def alphabet_ids(raw, alphabet):
    identity={c:i for i,c in enumerate(alphabet)}
    return [identity[c] for c in normalize(raw,'latin') if c in identity]

def latin_model(path, alphabet):
    counts=Counter()
    edges=Counter()
    for name in REFERENCES:
        encoding='latin-1' if name in ('pg16561.txt','pg826.txt') else 'utf-8'
        ys=alphabet_ids(strip_gutenberg((path/name).read_text(encoding=encoding)),alphabet)
        counts.update(ys)
        edges.update(zip(ys,ys[1:]))
    unigram=[(counts[i]+1)/(counts.total()+A) for i in range(A)]
    mass=[]
    for i in range(A):
        row=[edges[i,j]+1 for j in range(A)]
        mass.append([q/sum(row) for q in row])
    return unigram,mass,[[log2(q) for q in row] for row in mass]

def lexicon_bits(forms):
    # One-byte length and then literal ASCII bytes per word. Two-byte
    # row count and per-row dictionary size are counted separately.
    return sum(8*(1+len(w.encode('ascii'))) for w in forms)

def catalog(words, es, r):
    freq=[Counter() for _ in range(r)]
    for w,p in zip(words[:FIT],es[:FIT]):
        freq[p][w]+=1
    forms=[sorted(c,key=lambda w:(-c[w],w))[:A] for c in freq]
    return forms

def select_window(words):
    trials=[]
    for rows,skip in FAMILY:
        es=positions(len(words),rows,skip)
        forms=catalog(words,es,rows)
        look=[set(row) for row in forms]
        dictionary=sum(lexicon_bits(r) for r in forms)+16*(len(forms)+1)
        hit=0
        payload=0
        for w,p in zip(words[FIT:FIT+SELECT],es[FIT:FIT+SELECT]):
            payload+=5 # IDs 0..23 plus one escape
            if w in look[p]:
                hit+=1
            else:
                payload+=lexicon_bits([w])
        score=dictionary+payload
        trials.append((score,rows,skip,hit))
    return min(trials),sorted(trials)

def hungarian(scores):
    """Maximize a square assignment with potentials and shortest augmenting paths."""
    n=len(scores)
    row_potential=[0.]*(n+1)
    col_potential=[0.]*(n+1)
    matched_row=[0]*(n+1)
    back=[0]*(n+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        matched_row[0]=i
        col=0
        dist=[float('inf')]*(n+1)
        used=[False]*(n+1)
        while True:
            used[col]=True
            row=matched_row[col]
            delta=float('inf')
            next_col=0
            for j in range(1,n+1):
                if used[j]:
                    continue
                reduced=-scores[row-1][j-1]-row_potential[row]-col_potential[j]
                if reduced<dist[j]:
                    dist[j]=reduced
                    back[j]=col
                if dist[j]<delta:
                    delta=dist[j]
                    next_col=j
            for j in range(n+1):
                if used[j]:
                    row_potential[matched_row[j]]+=delta
                    col_potential[j]-=delta
                else:
                    dist[j]-=delta
            col=next_col
            if matched_row[col]==0:
                break
        while col:
            prior=back[col]
            matched_row[col]=matched_row[prior]
            col=prior
    out=[0]*n
    for col in range(1,n+1):
        out[matched_row[col]-1]=col-1
    return out

def compile_ids(words, es, forms):
    lookup=[{w:r*A+j for j,w in enumerate(row)} for r,row in enumerate(forms)]
    encoded=[lookup[p].get(w,UNKNOWN) for p,w in zip(es,words)]
    for i in range(FIT,len(words)):
        if encoded[i]!=UNKNOWN:
            continue
        w=words[i]
        lexicon=lookup[es[i]]
        similar=[id_ for q,id_ in lexicon.items()
                 if len(w)==len(q) and sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(w,q))==1]
        if len(similar)==1:
            encoded[i]=similar[0]
    return encoded

def cost(ids, model):
    return -sum(model[a][b] if a!=UNKNOWN and b!=UNKNOWN else -log2(A)
                for a,b in zip(ids,ids[1:]))

def fit_maps(words, es, rows, unigram, log_model, seed, optimize=True):
    forms=catalog(words,es,rows)
    encoded=compile_ids(words,es,forms)
    links=Counter((a,b) for a,b in zip(encoded[:FIT-1],encoded[1:FIT])
                  if a!=UNKNOWN and b!=UNKNOWN)
    assert not optimize or all(a//A!=b//A for a,b in links)
    left=[[] for _ in range(rows*A)]
    right=[[] for _ in range(rows*A)]
    for (a,b),n in links.items():
        left[b].append((a,n))
        right[a].append((b,n))
    reference=sorted(range(A),key=lambda i:(-unigram[i],i))
    initial=reference*rows
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    best=None
    for start in range(3 if optimize else 1):
        mapping=initial[:]
        if start:
            for row in range(rows):
                for _ in range(start+1):
                    a,b=rng.sample(range(row*A,(row+1)*A),2)
                    mapping[a],mapping[b]=mapping[b],mapping[a]
        previous=None
        for sweep in range(5 if optimize else 0):
            for row in range(rows):
                scores=[]
                for active in range(row*A,(row+1)*A):
                    backwards=[(log_model[mapping[i]],n) for i,n in left[active]]
                    forwards=[(mapping[i],n) for i,n in right[active]]
                    scores.append([sum(f[l]*n for f,n in backwards)+
                                   sum(log_model[l][f]*n for f,n in forwards) for l in range(A)])
                mapping[row*A:(row+1)*A]=hungarian(scores)
            objective=sum(log_model[mapping[a]][mapping[b]]*n for (a,b),n in links.items())
            if previous is not None:
                assert objective+1e-7>=previous
            previous=objective
        pred=[mapping[q] if q!=UNKNOWN else UNKNOWN for q in encoded]
        validation=cost(pred[FIT:FIT+SELECT],log_model)
        if best is None or validation<best[0]:
            best=validation,pred,mapping,start
    return best,forms,encoded

def noise(words, alphabet, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    choices={c:[x for x in alphabet if x!=c] for c in alphabet}
    return [''.join(rng.choice(choices[c]) if rng.random()<.02 else c for c in w) for w in words]

def sampled_plain(typ, unigram, mass, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    if typ=='iid':
        return rng.choices(range(A),weights=unigram,k=N)
    value=rng.choices(range(A),weights=unigram,k=1)[0]
    out=[value]
    for _ in range(N-1):
        value=rng.choices(range(A),weights=mass[value],k=1)[0]
        out.append(value)
    return out

def same_phase_p(decoded, es, model, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    bins=defaultdict(list)
    for i,e in enumerate(es):
        if decoded[i]!=UNKNOWN:
            bins[e].append(i)
    observed=cost(decoded,model)
    shorter=0
    for _ in range(39):
        shuffled=decoded[:]
        for values in bins.values():
            vals=[decoded[i] for i in values]
            rng.shuffle(vals)
            for i,val in zip(values,vals):
                shuffled[i]=val
        shorter+=cost(shuffled,model)<=observed
    return (1+shorter)/40

def count_exact(pred, truth):
    return sum(a==b for a,b in zip(pred,truth))/len(truth)

def rank_permutation(table):
    left=sorted(table)
    rank=0
    for entry in table:
        j=left.index(entry)
        rank+=j*factorial(len(left)-1)
        left.pop(j)
    return rank

def unrank_permutation(words, rank):
    left=words[:]
    table=[]
    while left:
        j,rank=divmod(rank,factorial(len(left)-1))
        table.append(left.pop(j))
    return table

def message_costs(tables, words, es, truth, alphabet, model, rows, skip, variant):
    parts=[]
    sizes={}
    def write(value, width, field):
        bits=format(value,f'0{width}b')
        assert len(bits)==width
        parts.append(bits)
        sizes[field]=sizes.get(field,0)+width
    def text_word(word, field):
        write(len(word),8,field)
        for c in word.encode('ascii'):
            write(c,8,field)

    text_word(''.join(alphabet),'alphabet_bits')
    write(len(truth),16,'schedule_bits')
    write(rows,16,'dictionary_bits')
    write(variant=='stays',1,'schedule_bits')
    periodic_width=ceil(log2(len(FAMILY)))
    if variant=='periodic':
        write(FAMILY.index((rows,skip)),periodic_width,'schedule_bits')
    else:
        for a,b in zip(es,es[1:]):
            write(a!=b,1,'schedule_bits')
    perm_width=(factorial(A)-1).bit_length()
    for table in tables:
        write(len(table),16,'dictionary_bits')
        for word in sorted(table):
            text_word(word,'dictionary_bits')
        write(rank_permutation(table),perm_width,'row_permutation_bits')
    for identity in truth:
        write(identity,5,'fixed_plain_payload_bits')
    literals=[(i,w) for i,(w,p,c) in enumerate(zip(words,es,truth)) if w!=tables[p][c]]
    count_width=len(truth).bit_length()
    index_width=(len(truth)-1).bit_length()
    write(len(literals),count_width,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
    for i,w in literals:
        write(i,index_width,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
        text_word(w,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
    stream=''.join(parts)
    pad=(-len(stream))%8
    # The stream length is inferred by reading the final literal count.
    padded=stream+'0'*pad
    packet=int(padded,2).to_bytes(len(padded)//8,'big')
    raw=bin(int.from_bytes(packet,'big'))[2:].zfill(8*len(packet))
    offset=0
    def read(width):
        nonlocal offset
        value=int(raw[offset:offset+width],2)
        offset+=width
        return value
    def read_word():
        return bytes(read(8) for _ in range(read(8))).decode('ascii')
    assert list(read_word())==alphabet
    n=read(16)
    r=read(16)
    if read(1):
        recovered_positions=[0]
        for _ in range(n-1):
            recovered_positions.append((recovered_positions[-1]+read(1))%r)
    else:
        inferred_r,inferred_skip=FAMILY[read(periodic_width)]
        assert inferred_r==r
        recovered_positions=positions(n,r,inferred_skip)
    recovered_tables=[]
    for _ in range(r):
        entries=[read_word() for _ in range(read(16))]
        recovered_tables.append(unrank_permutation(entries,read(perm_width)))
    recovered_truth=[read(5) for _ in range(n)]
    recovered_words=[recovered_tables[e][c] for e,c in zip(recovered_positions,recovered_truth)]
    for _ in range(read(n.bit_length())):
        i=read((n-1).bit_length())
        recovered_words[i]=read_word()
    assert recovered_positions==es and recovered_truth==truth and recovered_words==words
    assert recovered_tables==tables and offset==len(stream) and raw[offset:]=='0'*pad
    return dict(**sizes,padding_bits=pad,packet_bits=8*len(packet),
        model_plain_ideal_bits=cost(truth,model)+log2(A),literals=len(literals),verified_roundtrip=True)

def trial(name, clear, typ, pool, source, rows, skip, schedule, seed, alphabet, unigram, mass, model,
          noise_modes, remapped=True):
    writer=random.Random(seed)
    row_indices=writer.sample(range(len(source)),rows)
    true_table=[]
    for i in row_indices:
        words=list(source[i])
        if remapped:
            writer.shuffle(words)
        true_table.append(words)
    es=positions(N,rows,skip)
    if schedule=='stays':
        es=[0]
        for _ in range(N-1):
            es.append((es[-1]+(writer.random()>=.125))%rows)
    gold=clear if typ=='latin' else sampled_plain(typ,unigram,mass,seed+71901)
    cipher=[true_table[i][c] for i,c in zip(es,gold)]
    characters=sorted({c for row in true_table for w in row for c in w})
    assert [true_table[p].index(w) for p,w in zip(es,cipher)]==gold
    test_gold=gold[FIT+SELECT:]
    result=[]
    for is_noisy in noise_modes:
        observed=noise(cipher,characters,seed+81921) if is_noisy else cipher
        winner, trials=select_window(observed)
        _,r,k,val_hit=winner
        phase=positions(N,r,k)
        (vl,pred,key,start), forms, ids=fit_maps(observed,phase,r,unigram,model,seed+221)
        (oracle_loss, known_pred,*_), _, _=fit_maps(observed,es,rows,unigram,model,seed+221,
                                                   optimize=schedule=='periodic')
        (freq_loss,frequency,*_), _, _=fit_maps(observed,phase,r,unigram,model,seed+221,optimize=False)
        true_exact=[true_table[e].index(w) if w in true_table[e] else UNKNOWN
                    for w,e in zip(observed[FIT+SELECT:],es[FIT+SELECT:])]
        known_catalog=[set(row) for row in forms]
        exact=mean(w in known_catalog[e] for w,e in zip(observed[FIT+SELECT:],phase[FIT+SELECT:]))
        dec=pred[FIT+SELECT:]
        result.append(dict(work=name,kind=typ,pool=pool,rows=rows,skip=skip,schedule=schedule,seed=seed,
            remapped=remapped,
            historical_source_rows=[i+1+POOLS[pool][0] for i in row_indices],noisy=is_noisy,
            selected_rows=r,selected_skip=k,selected_family_correct=(schedule=='periodic' and (r,k)==(rows,skip)),
            candidate_validation_costs=trials,selected_validation_exact_coverage=val_hit/SELECT,
            held_apart_exact_catalog_coverage=exact,held_apart_decode_coverage=mean(q!=UNKNOWN for q in dec),
            selected_start=start,validation_fit_bits=vl,
            accuracy=count_exact(dec,test_gold),frequency_accuracy=count_exact(frequency[FIT+SELECT:],test_gold),
            known_schedule_accuracy=count_exact(known_pred[FIT+SELECT:],test_gold),
            known_schedule_optimizer=('assignment' if schedule=='periodic' else 'frequency'),
            full_table_exact_accuracy=count_exact(true_exact,test_gold),
            same_phase_p=same_phase_p(dec,phase[FIT+SELECT:],model,seed+156987),
            packet=message_costs(true_table,observed,es,gold,alphabet,model,rows,skip,schedule)))
    return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('references',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('table',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('works',type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    table_bytes=args.table.read_bytes()
    assert sha256(table_bytes).hexdigest()==TABLE_HASH
    full=list(csv.reader(table_bytes.decode().splitlines(),skipinitialspace=True))
    alphabet=full[0]
    assert len(alphabet)==A and len(set(alphabet))==A
    rows=[r for r in full[1:] if len(r)==A]
    pools={p:rows[a:b] for p,(a,b) in POOLS.items()}
    sets={p:{w for r in data for w in r} for p,data in pools.items()}
    assert all(len(v)==16*A for v in sets.values()) and len(set.union(*sets.values()))==len(sets)*16*A
    ug,m,model=latin_model(args.references,alphabet)
    cases=[]
    hashes={}
    for i,work in enumerate(sorted(args.works.glob('*.txt'))):
        hashes[work.name]=sha256(work.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        data=alphabet_ids(work.read_text(),alphabet)
        assert len(data)>=N
        data=data[:N]
        work_seed=760587+10991*i
        for j,(p,r) in enumerate((('challenge_a',8),('challenge_b',16))):
            for l,k in enumerate((0,17)):
                cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin',p,pools[p],r,k,'periodic',
                                   work_seed+1100*j+23*l,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,True)))
            cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin',p,pools[p],r,17,'periodic',
                               work_seed+40000+1100*j,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,True),remapped=False))
        for j,kind in enumerate(('iid','markov')):
            cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,kind,'development',pools['development'],8,17,'periodic',
                               work_seed+3200+29*j,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,)))
        cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin','challenge_a',pools['challenge_a'],8,0,'stays',
                           work_seed+5099,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,)))
    assert len(hashes)>=2
    results=dict(alphabet=alphabet,source_hashes=hashes,case_count=len(cases),
                 references={f:sha256((args.references/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in REFERENCES},
                 cases=cases)
    print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

detail.statement: In a frozen finite family of periodic row schedules, a ciphertext-only row assignment search identifies all 24 clean/noisy schedule instances over 12 independently remapped keys and three new Latin works. Mean exact recovery on the final 3,000 letters is 98.88% clean and 92.32% after 2% codeword character substitution. The joint 90% recovery and correct schedule gate is met in 12/12 clean and 10/12 noisy instances. A supplemental test preserving authentic column maps, with sampled row blocks and planted schedules, gives 98.51% and 91.72%, and meets the joint gate in 6/6 and 5/6. All three IID controls recover the schedule but average 26.09% exact characters. All three Markov controls generated from the fitting prior meet the joint gate and average 99.60%, so the criterion measures recovery and cannot identify meaningful plaintext. With geometric stays outside the finite family, three Latin cases average 2.39% exact characters. All 45 planted-key counterfactual packets round-trip the exact normalized plaintext and received ciphertext.

experiment.json.summary: A finite periodic family recovers independent planted row mappings but fails on stays and cannot distinguish Markov controls.

step.json.check: Implement and review a declarative evaluator before applying this family to manuscript data. Freeze additional disjoint word inventories and independent development controls for schedules with correctly modeled repeats, jumps or gaps. Compare unknown and fixed row schedules with fixed budgets and real decoding coverage as well as true letter accuracy, including unseen codewords and higher-order language controls. Charge explicit cipher table, row sequence and escaped items for candidate readings. Verify that arbitrary tables and adequate first-order controls cannot pass any separate reading criterion.

frozen_plan.negative_controls: Use IID and first-order Markov plaintext from the same external fit prior, also same-phase evaluation shuffles. Use out-of-family geometric stays at 1/8 as a schedule stress control.
frozen_plan.noise: Independent raw character replacement at 2%, preserving codeword length, using clean historical row-pool glyph inventory.
frozen_plan.oracle: Separate known-schedule vs full table and schedule baselines; no truth supplied to the learner.
frozen_plan.plaintext: New author-disjoint Latin works, first 12000 normalized model-alphabet letters after an explicitly delimited textual incipit. Test truth stays in evaluation.
frozen_plan.planted_challenges: For each independent work and challenge pool use 8 (A) or 16 (B) rows and two schedule types, ordinary cyclic and advance two every 17 tokens. Independently permute all row maps for each key. Keys are reused only between paired clean/noisy views.
frozen_plan.primary: Held-apart exact plaintext character accuracy, lexicon coverage, and stable row-family identification. A high-confidence joint calibration case requires at least .90 held-apart accuracy and an identified family.
frozen_plan.storage: Bill raw full ordered codeword dictionary and independently indexed row permutations plus finite schedule header and row origin. Include exact literal escapes for noisy words and identify uncharged quantities. Report without applying to Voynich pages.
frozen_plan.unknown_key: Determine row family by portable lexicon plus validation symbol cost, fit one-to-one letter maps by row coordinate assignments with a frozen external Latin bigram prior. Use frequency ranks and two perturbations as starts, five sweeps per start, select by validation likelihood without plaintext.
frozen_plan.unseen_spelling: Reserve a uniform literal/unknown event for schedule selection; at decoding use no imputation unless unique Hamming-distance-one match in the selected row. All-way unresolved tokens are unknown.

step.json.limits: All historical lexical pools are subsets of one edition rather than new manuscript witnesses. The supplemental test preserves the table’s column labels and uses newly sampled row orders and known planted schedule conditions. Runs share source works, so view multiplicities are not independent author counts. Noise is synthetic, preserves codeword length, and assumes token boundaries are known. The stay baseline with true row indices uses frequency ranking only. The known-key packet is an accounting control; its construction receives the planted values and it is not the size of a recovered reading. The schedule library was fixed locally before running the tests. No private or public Voynich hypotheses were evaluated.
step.json.method: Use three mutually word-disjoint 16-row pools from the same 131-row historical transcription, one for synthetic controls and two for evaluated Latin cases. Plant distinct row-wise random bijections for each key; pair the clean and noisy views. Draw 8 or 16 actual rows and fix the family library to widths 8/12/16 and cyclic or periodic step of two after each 17 or 41 positions. In the primary test the planted periodic nonzero interval is 17. Fit on 7,000 ciphertext words, select on the next 2,000, and evaluate on the final 3,000. Schedule selection charges the fitted literal row catalogs and five-bit known IDs or escaped literals in the validation window. For each fitted row retain up to 24 frequent spellings and use the frozen external Latin bigram prior to optimize a bijection by exact assignment between each row’s spellings and letters with other rows fixed. Use three starts and five sweeps; choose the best validation loss. For unseen spellings the only correction is a unique same-length distance-one match, otherwise the output is unknown. Same-phase shuffles keep unknown positions fixed. IID and Markov control plaintexts come from the external prior; out-of-family geometric stays are unannounced to the schedule selector.
step.json.packet_method: For cost disclosure only, the planted-key oracle sends the explicit 24-letter alphabet, full literal lexicon in ordered rows, per-row factoradic permutation rank, periodic family index or exact stay flags, normalized plaintext as fixed five-bit IDs, position-indexed literal exceptions, header and byte alignment. An independent field reader with lengths read from the packet verifies the row positions, full assigned table, normalized letters and every received codeword. The separate ideal bigram bits are an estimate, outside the actual packet. The actual packet costs range from 70,304 to 185,264 bits.

reproduction.assignment_smoke_test: All 315 seeded random matrices of size 1 to 7 matched exhaustive optimum; all nine finite candidate schedules passed a no-same-phase adjacency check.

scripts.calibrate.py:
import argparse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import csv
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from math import ceil, factorial, log2
from pathlib import Path
import random
from statistics import mean

from vs.refcorpus import normalize, strip_gutenberg

FIT, SELECT, TEST = 7000, 2000, 3000
N = FIT + SELECT + TEST
A = 24
UNKNOWN = -1
POOLS = {'development': (12,28), 'challenge_a': (47,63), 'challenge_b': (107,123)}
FAMILY = tuple((r,k) for r in (8,12,16) for k in (0,17,41))
TABLE_HASH = 'fe3f24a46dbc6b655eab8dbbd75addf84ee4a7dbd387ad802af75d02edfe5b4d'
REFERENCES = ('pg33849.txt','pg38708.txt','pg16561.txt','pg826.txt')

def positions(n, rows, skip):
    return [(i+(i//skip if skip else 0))%rows for i in range(n)]

def alphabet_ids(raw, alphabet):
    identity={c:i for i,c in enumerate(alphabet)}
    return [identity[c] for c in normalize(raw,'latin') if c in identity]

def latin_model(path, alphabet):
    counts=Counter()
    edges=Counter()
    for name in REFERENCES:
        encoding='latin-1' if name in ('pg16561.txt','pg826.txt') else 'utf-8'
        ys=alphabet_ids(strip_gutenberg((path/name).read_text(encoding=encoding)),alphabet)
        counts.update(ys)
        edges.update(zip(ys,ys[1:]))
    unigram=[(counts[i]+1)/(counts.total()+A) for i in range(A)]
    mass=[]
    for i in range(A):
        row=[edges[i,j]+1 for j in range(A)]
        mass.append([q/sum(row) for q in row])
    return unigram,mass,[[log2(q) for q in row] for row in mass]

def lexicon_bits(forms):
    # One-byte length and then literal ASCII bytes per word. Two-byte
    # row count and per-row dictionary size are counted separately.
    return sum(8*(1+len(w.encode('ascii'))) for w in forms)

def catalog(words, es, r):
    freq=[Counter() for _ in range(r)]
    for w,p in zip(words[:FIT],es[:FIT]):
        freq[p][w]+=1
    forms=[sorted(c,key=lambda w:(-c[w],w))[:A] for c in freq]
    return forms

def select_window(words):
    trials=[]
    for rows,skip in FAMILY:
        es=positions(len(words),rows,skip)
        forms=catalog(words,es,rows)
        look=[set(row) for row in forms]
        dictionary=sum(lexicon_bits(r) for r in forms)+16*(len(forms)+1)
        hit=0
        payload=0
        for w,p in zip(words[FIT:FIT+SELECT],es[FIT:FIT+SELECT]):
            payload+=5 # IDs 0..23 plus one escape
            if w in look[p]:
                hit+=1
            else:
                payload+=lexicon_bits([w])
        score=dictionary+payload
        trials.append((score,rows,skip,hit))
    return min(trials),sorted(trials)

def hungarian(scores):
    """Maximize a square assignment with potentials and shortest augmenting paths."""
    n=len(scores)
    row_potential=[0.]*(n+1)
    col_potential=[0.]*(n+1)
    matched_row=[0]*(n+1)
    back=[0]*(n+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        matched_row[0]=i
        col=0
        dist=[float('inf')]*(n+1)
        used=[False]*(n+1)
        while True:
            used[col]=True
            row=matched_row[col]
            delta=float('inf')
            next_col=0
            for j in range(1,n+1):
                if used[j]:
                    continue
                reduced=-scores[row-1][j-1]-row_potential[row]-col_potential[j]
                if reduced<dist[j]:
                    dist[j]=reduced
                    back[j]=col
                if dist[j]<delta:
                    delta=dist[j]
                    next_col=j
            for j in range(n+1):
                if used[j]:
                    row_potential[matched_row[j]]+=delta
                    col_potential[j]-=delta
                else:
                    dist[j]-=delta
            col=next_col
            if matched_row[col]==0:
                break
        while col:
            prior=back[col]
            matched_row[col]=matched_row[prior]
            col=prior
    out=[0]*n
    for col in range(1,n+1):
        out[matched_row[col]-1]=col-1
    return out

def compile_ids(words, es, forms):
    lookup=[{w:r*A+j for j,w in enumerate(row)} for r,row in enumerate(forms)]
    encoded=[lookup[p].get(w,UNKNOWN) for p,w in zip(es,words)]
    for i in range(FIT,len(words)):
        if encoded[i]!=UNKNOWN:
            continue
        w=words[i]
        lexicon=lookup[es[i]]
        similar=[id_ for q,id_ in lexicon.items()
                 if len(w)==len(q) and sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(w,q))==1]
        if len(similar)==1:
            encoded[i]=similar[0]
    return encoded

def cost(ids, model):
    return -sum(model[a][b] if a!=UNKNOWN and b!=UNKNOWN else -log2(A)
                for a,b in zip(ids,ids[1:]))

def fit_maps(words, es, rows, unigram, log_model, seed, optimize=True):
    forms=catalog(words,es,rows)
    encoded=compile_ids(words,es,forms)
    links=Counter((a,b) for a,b in zip(encoded[:FIT-1],encoded[1:FIT])
                  if a!=UNKNOWN and b!=UNKNOWN)
    assert not optimize or all(a//A!=b//A for a,b in links)
    left=[[] for _ in range(rows*A)]
    right=[[] for _ in range(rows*A)]
    for (a,b),n in links.items():
        left[b].append((a,n))
        right[a].append((b,n))
    reference=sorted(range(A),key=lambda i:(-unigram[i],i))
    initial=reference*rows
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    best=None
    for start in range(3 if optimize else 1):
        mapping=initial[:]
        if start:
            for row in range(rows):
                for _ in range(start+1):
                    a,b=rng.sample(range(row*A,(row+1)*A),2)
                    mapping[a],mapping[b]=mapping[b],mapping[a]
        previous=None
        for sweep in range(5 if optimize else 0):
            for row in range(rows):
                scores=[]
                for active in range(row*A,(row+1)*A):
                    backwards=[(log_model[mapping[i]],n) for i,n in left[active]]
                    forwards=[(mapping[i],n) for i,n in right[active]]
                    scores.append([sum(f[l]*n for f,n in backwards)+
                                   sum(log_model[l][f]*n for f,n in forwards) for l in range(A)])
                mapping[row*A:(row+1)*A]=hungarian(scores)
            objective=sum(log_model[mapping[a]][mapping[b]]*n for (a,b),n in links.items())
            if previous is not None:
                assert objective+1e-7>=previous
            previous=objective
        pred=[mapping[q] if q!=UNKNOWN else UNKNOWN for q in encoded]
        validation=cost(pred[FIT:FIT+SELECT],log_model)
        if best is None or validation<best[0]:
            best=validation,pred,mapping,start
    return best,forms,encoded

def noise(words, alphabet, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    choices={c:[x for x in alphabet if x!=c] for c in alphabet}
    return [''.join(rng.choice(choices[c]) if rng.random()<.02 else c for c in w) for w in words]

def sampled_plain(typ, unigram, mass, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    if typ=='iid':
        return rng.choices(range(A),weights=unigram,k=N)
    value=rng.choices(range(A),weights=unigram,k=1)[0]
    out=[value]
    for _ in range(N-1):
        value=rng.choices(range(A),weights=mass[value],k=1)[0]
        out.append(value)
    return out

def same_phase_p(decoded, es, model, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    bins=defaultdict(list)
    for i,e in enumerate(es):
        if decoded[i]!=UNKNOWN:
            bins[e].append(i)
    observed=cost(decoded,model)
    shorter=0
    for _ in range(39):
        shuffled=decoded[:]
        for values in bins.values():
            vals=[decoded[i] for i in values]
            rng.shuffle(vals)
            for i,val in zip(values,vals):
                shuffled[i]=val
        shorter+=cost(shuffled,model)<=observed
    return (1+shorter)/40

def count_exact(pred, truth):
    return sum(a==b for a,b in zip(pred,truth))/len(truth)

def rank_permutation(table):
    left=sorted(table)
    rank=0
    for entry in table:
        j=left.index(entry)
        rank+=j*factorial(len(left)-1)
        left.pop(j)
    return rank

def unrank_permutation(words, rank):
    left=words[:]
    table=[]
    while left:
        j,rank=divmod(rank,factorial(len(left)-1))
        table.append(left.pop(j))
    return table

def message_costs(tables, words, es, truth, alphabet, model, rows, skip, variant):
    parts=[]
    sizes={}
    def write(value, width, field):
        bits=format(value,f'0{width}b')
        assert len(bits)==width
        parts.append(bits)
        sizes[field]=sizes.get(field,0)+width
    def text_word(word, field):
        write(len(word),8,field)
        for c in word.encode('ascii'):
            write(c,8,field)

    text_word(''.join(alphabet),'alphabet_bits')
    write(len(truth),16,'schedule_bits')
    write(rows,16,'dictionary_bits')
    write(variant=='stays',1,'schedule_bits')
    periodic_width=ceil(log2(len(FAMILY)))
    if variant=='periodic':
        write(FAMILY.index((rows,skip)),periodic_width,'schedule_bits')
    else:
        for a,b in zip(es,es[1:]):
            write(a!=b,1,'schedule_bits')
    perm_width=(factorial(A)-1).bit_length()
    for table in tables:
        write(len(table),16,'dictionary_bits')
        for word in sorted(table):
            text_word(word,'dictionary_bits')
        write(rank_permutation(table),perm_width,'row_permutation_bits')
    for identity in truth:
        write(identity,5,'fixed_plain_payload_bits')
    literals=[(i,w) for i,(w,p,c) in enumerate(zip(words,es,truth)) if w!=tables[p][c]]
    count_width=len(truth).bit_length()
    index_width=(len(truth)-1).bit_length()
    write(len(literals),count_width,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
    for i,w in literals:
        write(i,index_width,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
        text_word(w,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
    stream=''.join(parts)
    pad=(-len(stream))%8
    # The stream length is inferred by reading the final literal count.
    padded=stream+'0'*pad
    packet=int(padded,2).to_bytes(len(padded)//8,'big')
    raw=bin(int.from_bytes(packet,'big'))[2:].zfill(8*len(packet))
    offset=0
    def read(width):
        nonlocal offset
        value=int(raw[offset:offset+width],2)
        offset+=width
        return value
    def read_word():
        return bytes(read(8) for _ in range(read(8))).decode('ascii')
    assert list(read_word())==alphabet
    n=read(16)
    r=read(16)
    if read(1):
        recovered_positions=[0]
        for _ in range(n-1):
            recovered_positions.append((recovered_positions[-1]+read(1))%r)
    else:
        inferred_r,inferred_skip=FAMILY[read(periodic_width)]
        assert inferred_r==r
        recovered_positions=positions(n,r,inferred_skip)
    recovered_tables=[]
    for _ in range(r):
        entries=[read_word() for _ in range(read(16))]
        recovered_tables.append(unrank_permutation(entries,read(perm_width)))
    recovered_truth=[read(5) for _ in range(n)]
    recovered_words=[recovered_tables[e][c] for e,c in zip(recovered_positions,recovered_truth)]
    for _ in range(read(n.bit_length())):
        i=read((n-1).bit_length())
        recovered_words[i]=read_word()
    assert recovered_positions==es and recovered_truth==truth and recovered_words==words
    assert recovered_tables==tables and offset==len(stream) and raw[offset:]=='0'*pad
    return dict(**sizes,padding_bits=pad,packet_bits=8*len(packet),
        model_plain_ideal_bits=cost(truth,model)+log2(A),literals=len(literals),verified_roundtrip=True)

def trial(name, clear, typ, pool, source, rows, skip, schedule, seed, alphabet, unigram, mass, model,
          noise_modes, remapped=True):
    writer=random.Random(seed)
    row_indices=writer.sample(range(len(source)),rows)
    true_table=[]
    for i in row_indices:
        words=list(source[i])
        if remapped:
            writer.shuffle(words)
        true_table.append(words)
    es=positions(N,rows,skip)
    if schedule=='stays':
        es=[0]
        for _ in range(N-1):
            es.append((es[-1]+(writer.random()>=.125))%rows)
    gold=clear if typ=='latin' else sampled_plain(typ,unigram,mass,seed+71901)
    cipher=[true_table[i][c] for i,c in zip(es,gold)]
    characters=sorted({c for row in true_table for w in row for c in w})
    assert [true_table[p].index(w) for p,w in zip(es,cipher)]==gold
    test_gold=gold[FIT+SELECT:]
    result=[]
    for is_noisy in noise_modes:
        observed=noise(cipher,characters,seed+81921) if is_noisy else cipher
        winner, trials=select_window(observed)
        _,r,k,val_hit=winner
        phase=positions(N,r,k)
        (vl,pred,key,start), forms, ids=fit_maps(observed,phase,r,unigram,model,seed+221)
        (oracle_loss, known_pred,*_), _, _=fit_maps(observed,es,rows,unigram,model,seed+221,
                                                   optimize=schedule=='periodic')
        (freq_loss,frequency,*_), _, _=fit_maps(observed,phase,r,unigram,model,seed+221,optimize=False)
        true_exact=[true_table[e].index(w) if w in true_table[e] else UNKNOWN
                    for w,e in zip(observed[FIT+SELECT:],es[FIT+SELECT:])]
        known_catalog=[set(row) for row in forms]
        exact=mean(w in known_catalog[e] for w,e in zip(observed[FIT+SELECT:],phase[FIT+SELECT:]))
        dec=pred[FIT+SELECT:]
        result.append(dict(work=name,kind=typ,pool=pool,rows=rows,skip=skip,schedule=schedule,seed=seed,
            remapped=remapped,
            historical_source_rows=[i+1+POOLS[pool][0] for i in row_indices],noisy=is_noisy,
            selected_rows=r,selected_skip=k,selected_family_correct=(schedule=='periodic' and (r,k)==(rows,skip)),
            candidate_validation_costs=trials,selected_validation_exact_coverage=val_hit/SELECT,
            held_apart_exact_catalog_coverage=exact,held_apart_decode_coverage=mean(q!=UNKNOWN for q in dec),
            selected_start=start,validation_fit_bits=vl,
            accuracy=count_exact(dec,test_gold),frequency_accuracy=count_exact(frequency[FIT+SELECT:],test_gold),
            known_schedule_accuracy=count_exact(known_pred[FIT+SELECT:],test_gold),
            known_schedule_optimizer=('assignment' if schedule=='periodic' else 'frequency'),
            full_table_exact_accuracy=count_exact(true_exact,test_gold),
            same_phase_p=same_phase_p(dec,phase[FIT+SELECT:],model,seed+156987),
            packet=message_costs(true_table,observed,es,gold,alphabet,model,rows,skip,schedule)))
    return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('references',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('table',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('works',type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    table_bytes=args.table.read_bytes()
    assert sha256(table_bytes).hexdigest()==TABLE_HASH
    full=list(csv.reader(table_bytes.decode().splitlines(),skipinitialspace=True))
    alphabet=full[0]
    assert len(alphabet)==A and len(set(alphabet))==A
    rows=[r for r in full[1:] if len(r)==A]
    pools={p:rows[a:b] for p,(a,b) in POOLS.items()}
    sets={p:{w for r in data for w in r} for p,data in pools.items()}
    assert all(len(v)==16*A for v in sets.values()) and len(set.union(*sets.values()))==len(sets)*16*A
    ug,m,model=latin_model(args.references,alphabet)
    cases=[]
    hashes={}
    for i,work in enumerate(sorted(args.works.glob('*.txt'))):
        hashes[work.name]=sha256(work.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        data=alphabet_ids(work.read_text(),alphabet)
        assert len(data)>=N
        data=data[:N]
        work_seed=760587+10991*i
        for j,(p,r) in enumerate((('challenge_a',8),('challenge_b',16))):
            for l,k in enumerate((0,17)):
                cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin',p,pools[p],r,k,'periodic',
                                   work_seed+1100*j+23*l,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,True)))
            cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin',p,pools[p],r,17,'periodic',
                               work_seed+40000+1100*j,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,True),remapped=False))
        for j,kind in enumerate(('iid','markov')):
            cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,kind,'development',pools['development'],8,17,'periodic',
                               work_seed+3200+29*j,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,)))
        cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin','challenge_a',pools['challenge_a'],8,0,'stays',
                           work_seed+5099,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,)))
    assert len(hashes)>=2
    results=dict(alphabet=alphabet,source_hashes=hashes,case_count=len(cases),
                 references={f:sha256((args.references/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in REFERENCES},
                 cases=cases)
    print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

Download the four original Latin source files as in source manifest and verify their digests. Run extract-sources.py per source manifest; then run PYTHONPATH=. python3 calibrate.py data/raw /path/to/table.csv /path/to/source-texts from the project root.

corpus.normalization: Lowercase, expand ae and oe ligatures, apply NFKD, remove every character outside a–z. Preserve j and v. Write UTF-8 with no trailing newline.
corpus.reproduction: Acquire the exact raw witnesses at the recorded URLs under raw/, verify their SHA-256 digests, and run python3 extract-sources.py.

step.json.statement: In a frozen finite family of periodic row schedules, a ciphertext-only row assignment search identifies all 24 clean/noisy schedule instances over 12 independently remapped keys and three new Latin works. Mean exact recovery on the final 3,000 letters is 98.88% clean and 92.32% after 2% codeword character substitution. The joint 90% recovery and correct schedule gate is met in 12/12 clean and 10/12 noisy instances. A supplemental test preserving authentic column maps, with sampled row blocks and planted schedules, gives 98.51% and 91.72%, and meets the joint gate in 6/6 and 5/6. All three IID controls recover the schedule but average 26.09% exact characters. All three Markov controls generated from the fitting prior meet the joint gate and average 99.60%, so the criterion measures recovery and cannot identify meaningful plaintext. With geometric stays outside the finite family, three Latin cases average 2.39% exact characters. All 45 planted-key counterfactual packets round-trip the exact normalized plaintext and received ciphertext.

detail.limitations: The northern intersection depends on how faint coherent ink is delimited; its nominal overlap is below conservative manual edge tolerance. Top group angles cannot put f69v.8 strictly ahead of f69v.11 by proximity to vertical. The polar geometry assumes a common central hub for drawing and writing even though a free band fit drifts between rings. RGB is not a pigment assay. Independently reproduced positions and transcriber ordering do not prove design intention. The apparent reading direction of one engraved or written line does not order the neighboring radial lines.

methods.alignment: After saving the image-only readings, match closure/opening group shapes in ZL loci f69v.1–3 to either corridor and compare rectified inward radial groups to ZL loci f69v.31 then .4 through .11. Review IT, RF and GC locus IDs as separate transcription conventions. All four witnesses have 28 radial loci; only ZL supplies explicit clock comments here.
methods.blind_phase: Two separate ring readings and an additional radial reader worked on image-only crops. Gap angles follow manual boundaries of coherent upright brown strokes in unwrapped images. View uncertain strokes separately. The primary nearest-word comparison uses the median painted ink pixels of a manually delimited radial group. Angles are clockwise from the image vertical and are not the manuscript’s intrinsic coordinates.
methods.controls: Compare the nearby ordinary ink gaps measured on the same unwrapping, re-angle the main endpoints around an alternative hub, compare both 28-cap gap counts, and compare cap vs ink bearings. No mansion names or scores were used.
methods.paint: One fixed RGB/luminance threshold over the partial center annulus gives .831 in the top sector and .655 in the northwest. A second frame and green-specific hue proxy give the top sector .362 and the next-highest sector .158; a generic dark blue/green mask gives .573 top compared to .613 northwest. Registration and color definitions are approximate. A distinct sensitivity uses square patches and nine thresholds.

blind_radial.bearing_definition: degrees clockwise from scan up; x right, y down, angles wrapped [−180,180)
blind_radial.cream_spoke_caveat: Approximate hand tracing from 50–250 px polar unwrap; outlines fade and spokes have finite width.
blind_radial.provenance: Source image inspected without looking up any transliteration, prior PR, or list during this measurement.
blind_radial.radial_text_local_direction: Inward. With the outside alphabetic end at the left and the interior bar end at the right, upright tall glyphs occur at the top of the rectified writing lines. Opposite orientation places the tall glyphs below. A radial baseline has no tangential writing vector; global order through the strips is a separate question.
blind_radial.upper_sector: The contiguous blue-green section is between the roughly −25 and +17 degree cream spokes. Other sectors show blue blotches and small star figures, and some paint losses make intensity variable.

circular_alignment.conclusion: The ZL ring loci are aligned to the northwest corridor near scan 11:00, while the painted north wedge lies within a second corridor of larger-than-ordinary spaces. The scan and these text row origins leave the radial sequence origin unsettled.

circular_alignment.method: For each ring compare shape of the ZL closure and opening groups on both sides of each candidate gap. The ordered pairing across three rings distinguishes the candidate gaps even when individual faint signs are uncertain. Match is transcription alignment, not a claim of exact independent transliteration or original manuscript reading.
circular_alignment.phase: Unblinded alignment only after independently freezing image measurements. No historical word lists consulted.

independent_ink.blind_conclusion: Both corridors show enlarged spaces; northwest common overlap is roughly -34.6 to -29.3 degrees, and its outer/middle gaps are wider than north. North gap midpoints vary by about 5 degrees and approximately align within one sector. The darkest paint sector independently favors a north grouping but cannot disambiguate an exact start or circular order.

independent_ink.methods: Blind, image only. Axis 0 degrees = image up, positive clockwise. Origins, radii and crop offset refer to public native Yale pixels. Unwrap x=1128+r*sin(theta), y=1150-r*cos(theta) in crop coordinates at 0.1 degree and 1 pixel. Estimate gap bounds by coherent exterior stroke edges in the unwrapped ribbons. Allow approximately 1 degree per edge for faded marks; do not equate gaps to exact pixel-total absence.
independent_ink.orientation: Ring glyphs upright in clockwise polar unwrap with ascenders away from center. Individual radial words are written centerward and rotated along their respective rays. Ring writing direction does not establish circular order of spatially separate radial words, or that any gap establishes a semantic beginning.

raster_pigment_comparison.interpretation: One contiguous dark, green-blue and comparatively star-poor north sector. Northwest neighbor also contains considerable dark blue and retains visible motif detail. Relative strongest cool/dark coverage persists when luma threshold moves 110–140 and R-B limit 15–35; these are image-color measurements, not pigment or intent identification.

independent_ink.ray_note: Eight tan rays at these approximate azimuths. Broad, curved ray boundaries and raster abrasion make the values approximate; sectors include visible stars or star fragments except visually star-poor dark north wedge.

main_ink.evidence_note: Click edge estimates on polar bands of standing brown glyphs; include faint coherent strokes, exclude isolated punctate stain where disconnected. Zero-degree corridor overlap is narrow. Broader upper-left gaps are not visibly accompanied by the special central fill. The direction of radial layout is not implied by glyph orientation. Eight cream radial rays were counted; their tips are diffuse and several meet the colored wheel.

ordinary_spacing.note: Ten nearby short blank intervals and both corridors measured in the same star-centered polar raster. They are separations between visible clusters, not claims about lexical tokenization. Edges to about one degree; intervals with strokes too faint to locate were skipped.

left_boundary.observation: The long blue cap at .31 and next short pale cap at .4 are visually adjacent in the same alternating cycle. The .31 word has two clear-looking inward groups, while .4 has a possible narrow division. This angular spacing is on the large side of the normal cap distribution and is not unique. No conspicuous keyed radial direction change is visible in the sampled strip.

radial_alignment.notes: Glyph shapes were read inward in rectified local strips and matched clockwise in order to the nearby ZL entries only after the geometry was locked. The distinctive paired .31 mark and paired-looking .4 sit on the same local sequence as .5 through .9. Clock labels are approximate, not angular measurements. .9 is the cap closest to scan-up but the ink centers of .9 and .10 have almost equal absolute angles (about six degrees); the difference is beneath localization and center uncertainty.

radial_sector_chroma.analysis: Approximate RGB proxy applied only to the central sector annulus and trimmed visual spoke angles. This measures visible chroma and darkness, not paint chemistry or originality.
radial_sector_chroma.proxy_green_dark: G−R > 6 and G−B > 3 and RGB-average below 175

Run python3 measure.py f69v-native.jpg main_ink.json data/raw radial_alignment.json blind_radial.json ordinary_spacing.json. Re-render native unwrapping with the included polar script. Image blobs are cited by native crop URLs and file hashes.

import math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FILE = PATH / 'blind/ink-wheel-native.jpg'
CROP_OFFSET = (750, 590)
CENTER = (1128, 1150)
RGB = np.array(Image.open(FILE).convert('RGB'))

def polar(amin, amax, inner, outer, step=0.1):
    theta = np.arange(amin, amax, step)
    t = np.radians(theta)
    r = np.arange(outer,inner,-1)
    x = CENTER[0] + r[:, None] * np.sin(t)
    y = CENTER[1] - r[:, None] * np.cos(t)
    arr = np.stack([map_coordinates(RGB[:, :, channel], [y,x], order=1)
                    for channel in range(3)],axis=2)
    return theta,r,arr

def plot(amin, amax, inner, outer, prefix, step=.1):
    a,r,rgb = polar(amin,amax,inner,outer,step)
    img = Image.new('RGB', (len(a),len(r)+28), 'white')
    img.paste(Image.fromarray(rgb),(0,28))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for t in range(amin,amax,5 if amax-amin<=180 else 15):
        x = int(round((t-amin)/step))
        d.text((x+2,3),str(t),fill='black')
        d.line((x,19,x,28),fill='black')
    img.save(PATH / f'{prefix}.jpg',quality=96)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    plot(-60,60,730,1120,'ink-north-rings')
    plot(-180,180,55,265,'ink-star-polar',.25)
    for amin in range(-180,180,90):
        plot(amin,amin+90,700,1130,f'ink-ring-{amin:+d}')

import argparse
from math import asin, atan2, cos, degrees, hypot, radians, sin
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
import json
import re

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def angle(point, center):
    return degrees(atan2(point[0]-center[0],center[1]-point[1]))

def span(intervals):
    left,right=max(a for a,_ in intervals),min(b for _,b in intervals)
    return [left,right],right-left

def transform_deg(theta,r,old,new):
    t=radians(theta)
    xy=old[0]+r*sin(t),old[1]-r*cos(t)
    return angle(xy,new)

def colors(img, targets, center):
    grid=np.asarray(img.convert('RGB'), dtype=float)
    results={}
    for site in targets:
        a=radians(site['angle'])
        ctrx,ctry=round(center[0]+sin(a)*site['r']),round(center[1]-cos(a)*site['r'])
        vals=grid[ctry-24:ctry+25,ctrx-24:ctrx+25]
        patch=np.mean(vals,axis=(0,1))
        dominance=(vals[:,:,1]+vals[:,:,2])/2-vals[:,:,0]
        brightness=vals.mean(axis=2)
        quantile_xyz=[]
        for d in (2,8,14):
            for lum in (120,150,180):
                quantile_xyz.append({'dominance':d,'mean_rgb_limit':lum,
                    'fraction':float(np.mean((dominance>d)&(brightness<lum)))})
        results[site['name']]=dict(centre_local_xy=[ctrx,ctry],mean_rgb=patch.tolist(), thresholds=quantile_xyz)
    return results

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('image',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('points',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('transcriptions',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('radial_alignment',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('radial_geometry',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('ring_spacing',type=Path)
    args=ap.parse_args()
    original=json.loads(args.points.read_text())
    b=original['basis']
    c,alt=b['center_local_xy'],b['alt_center_local_xy']
    radii={'outer':1015,'middle':950,'inner':850}
    gap_results={}
    for name,gaps in original['manual_gaps_deg'].items():
        cover,w=span(list(gaps.values()))
        alt_intervals={k:[transform_deg(t,radii[k],c,alt) for t in ts] for k,ts in gaps.items()}
        other,uw=span(list(alt_intervals.values()))
        gap_results[name]=dict(widths={k:b-a for k,(a,b) in gaps.items()},all_three_intersection=cover,
            intersection_width=w,alternative_center_intervals=alt_intervals,alternative_intersection=other,
            alternative_intersection_width=uw)
    timings={}
    for view,file in (('ZL','ZL3b-n.txt'),('IT','IT2a-n.txt'),('RF','RF1b-e.txt'),('GC','GC2a-n.txt')):
        lines=re.findall(r'^<(f69v\.\d+),[^>]*R[^>]*>[^\S\n]*([^\n]*)',
                         (args.transcriptions/file).read_text(),flags=re.M)
        records=[(id_,*m.groups()) for id_,body in lines
                 if (m:=re.match(r'<!(\d\d):(\d\d)>',body))]
        candidates=[(id_,float((int(h)*30+float(m)/2+180)%360-180)) for id_,h,m in records]
        timings[view]=dict(radial_loci=len(lines),explicit_clock_positions=len(candidates),
            top_3_clock_positions=sorted(candidates,key=lambda a:abs(a[1]))[:3],
            origin_1030_1130=[x for x in candidates if -45<=x[1]<=-15],
            compared_loci={id_:body for id_,body in lines if int(id_.split('.')[1]) in (4,7,8,9,10,11,31)})
    aligned=json.loads(args.radial_alignment.read_text())
    geo=json.loads(args.radial_geometry.read_text())
    labels=[e for e in aligned['loci_after_zl_alignment'] if e['locus'] in
            {f'f69v.{i}' for i in (8,9,10,11)}]
    cap_order=sorted(x['bearing_deg'] for x in geo['caps'])
    cap_gaps=[b-a for a,b in zip(cap_order,cap_order[1:]+[cap_order[0]+360])]
    near=[]
    for label in labels:
        xy=label['native_ink_group_xy']
        h=geo['radial_hub_native_xy']
        toler=label['approximately_ink_localization_tolerance_px']+geo['hub_uncertainty_px']
        estimate=angle(xy,h)
        delta=degrees(asin(toler/hypot(xy[0]-h[0],xy[1]-h[1])))
        near.append(dict(locus=label['locus'],azimuth_deg=estimate,
                         conservative_localization_interval_deg=[estimate-delta,estimate+delta]))
    neighbors=json.loads(args.ring_spacing.read_text())
    neighbor_summary={k:dict(count=len(x),median=median(b-a for a,b in x),maximum=max(b-a for a,b in x))
                      for k,x in neighbors.items() if isinstance(x,list)}
    out=dict(gaps=gap_results,ordinary_spacing=neighbor_summary,
             cap_gap_span=[min(cap_gaps),median(cap_gaps),max(cap_gaps)],
             scanned_near_top_ink=near,
             pigment=colors(Image.open(args.image),original['central_pigment'],c),radial_clock=timings)
    print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

from math import cos, radians, sin
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

root=Path(sys.argv[1])/'blind'
img=Image.open(root/'f69v-native.jpg').convert('RGB')
for name,(x,y) in [('star',(1075,1119)),('offset',(1063,1107))]:
    for idx,(start,stop) in enumerate([(-100,50),(50,200),(195,295)]):
        w=12*(stop-start)+1
        h=400
        result=Image.new('RGB',(w,h),(245,240,230))
        src=img.load()
        dest=result.load()
        for px in range(w):
            a=radians(start+px/12)
            ux,uy=sin(a),-cos(a)
            for py in range(h):
                r=1105-py
                a1,b1=round(x+ux*r),round(y+uy*r)
                if 0<=a1<img.width and 0<=b1<img.height:
                    dest[px,py]=src[a1,b1]
        draw=ImageDraw.Draw(result,'RGBA')
        for degree in range(start,stop+1,5):
            i=(degree-start)*12
            draw.line((i,0,i,h),fill=(40,95,215,78),width=1)
            draw.text((i+2,0 if degree%10 else 18),str(degree),fill=(0,30,138,255))
        for r in range(750,1101,50):
            j=1105-r
            draw.line((0,j,w,j),fill=(40,95,215,55),width=1)
            draw.text((0,j),str(r),fill=(0,30,138,255))
        result.save(root/f'polar-{name}-{idx}.png')

"""Image-only audit of the green caps and top radial ink on the Yale f69v crop."""
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import label, binary_opening, binary_closing, map_coordinates
from math import atan2, degrees, hypot
from hashlib import sha256
import json

work=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
raw=work/'blind/radial-full.jpg'
im=np.array(Image.open(raw)).astype(float)
origin=(750,620)
hub=(1882.,1746.)
native_height,native_width=im.shape[:2]
r,g,b=im.transpose(2,0,1)
y,x=np.indices(r.shape)
x=x+origin[0]
y=y+origin[1]
distance=np.hypot(x-hub[0],y-hub[1])
mask=(g-r>10)&(g-b>8)&(distance>380)&(distance<590)&(r+g+b<450)
mask=binary_closing(binary_opening(mask,iterations=2),iterations=4)
marks,k=label(mask)
components=[]
for i in range(1,k+1):
    yy,xx=np.where(marks==i)
    if len(yy)<=400:
        continue
    cx=origin[0]+xx.mean()
    cy=origin[1]+yy.mean()
    a=degrees(atan2(cx-hub[0],hub[1]-cy))
    radius=hypot(cx-hub[0],cy-hub[1])
    components.append(dict(bearing_deg=round(a,3),radius_px=round(radius,2),
                           center_xy=[round(cx,2),round(cy,2)],pixels=len(yy)))
# An isolated green mark on a bar farther inward and within four degrees
# of its cap is not a second cap. Confirm these two near-coincident pairs on
# the raw scan; very small isolated green marks account for no extra heads.
included=[]
excluded=[]
for q in sorted(components,key=lambda q:-q['radius_px']):
    other=next((p for p in included if abs(q['bearing_deg']-p['bearing_deg'])<4),None)
    if other is not None:
        excluded.append(dict(component=q,head_bearing=other['bearing_deg']))
        continue
    included.append(q)
included.sort(key=lambda q:q['bearing_deg'])
for i,q in enumerate(included):
    q['cw_rank_from_top_left']=((i-12)%len(included))+1
assert len(included)==28
ink=[]
# Delineate the visible top four word groups on a rectified view: radius
# outwards along x, clockwise tangent along y relative to each axis.
# Rows and boxes chosen from the image, without using any transliteration.
for axis,bbox in [(-18,(515,-19,734,36)),(-6,(599,-23,742,36)),
                  (5,(518,-35,720,39)),(16,(608,-29,748,39))]:
    theta=np.radians(axis)
    lo_u,lo_v,hi_u,hi_v=bbox
    uu=np.arange(lo_u,hi_u)[None,:]
    vv=np.arange(lo_v,hi_v)[:,None]
    x=hub[0]+uu*np.sin(theta)+vv*np.cos(theta)
    y=hub[1]-uu*np.cos(theta)+vv*np.sin(theta)
    rgb=np.stack([map_coordinates(im[:,:,j],(y-origin[1],x-origin[0]),order=1,cval=240)
                  for j in range(3)],axis=2)
    nr,ng,nb=rgb.transpose(2,0,1)
    keep=((nr+ng+nb)/3<175)&(nr-nb>18)&(nr>=ng)
    cx=float(np.median(x[keep]))
    cy=float(np.median(y[keep]))
    ink.append(dict(axis_deg=axis,local_roi_uv=list(bbox),ink_median_xy=[round(cx,1),round(cy,1)],
                    approximate_ink_bearing_deg=round(degrees(atan2(cx-hub[0],hub[1]-cy)),2),
                    pixels=int(keep.sum())))
out=dict(
    canvas="https://collections.library.yale.edu/manifests/oid/2002046/canvas/1006199",
    source="https://collections.library.yale.edu/iiif/2/1006199/750,620,2220,2210/full/0/default.jpg",
    raw_sha256=sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),native_crop_xywh=[*origin,native_width,native_height],
    wheel_panel_approx_bounds_native_xyxy=[620,130,3040,3730],
    drawing_ink_approx_bounds_native_xyxy=[850,680,2940,2750],
    radial_hub_native_xy=list(hub),hub_uncertainty_px=8,
    bearing_definition='degrees clockwise from scan up; x right, y down, angles wrapped [−180,180)',
    caps=included,excluded_inner_green_fragments=excluded,
    ink_top_four=ink,ink_group_uncertainty_px=15,
    approximate_cream_spoke_bearings_deg=[-171,-113,-72,-25,17,68,103,144],
    cream_spoke_count=8,cream_spoke_caveat="Approximate hand tracing from 50–250 px polar unwrap; outlines fade and spokes have finite width.",
    upper_sector="The contiguous blue-green section is between the roughly −25 and +17 degree cream spokes. Other sectors show blue blotches and small star figures, and some paint losses make intensity variable.",
    radial_text_local_direction="Inward. With the outside alphabetic end at the left and the interior bar end at the right, upright tall glyphs occur at the top of the rectified writing lines. Opposite orientation places the tall glyphs below. A radial baseline has no tangential writing vector; global order through the strips is a separate question.",
    provenance="Source image inspected without looking up any transliteration, prior PR, or list during this measurement.",
)
(work/'radial_blind_geometry.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')

"""Reproducible approximate chroma check of inner sectors of f69v."""
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import label
import numpy as np
import json

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
aux=json.loads((p/'radial_blind_geometry.json').read_text())
crop=aux['native_crop_xywh']
cx,cy=aux['radial_hub_native_xy']
spokes=aux['approximate_cream_spoke_bearings_deg']
spokes.append(spokes[0]+360)
rect=(int(cx)-255,int(cy)-255,int(cx)+256,int(cy)+256)
im=np.array(Image.open(p/'blind/radial-full.jpg').crop(tuple(a-crop[i%2] for i,a in enumerate(rect)))).astype(float)
R,G,B=im.transpose(2,0,1)
y,x=np.indices(R.shape)
light=(R+G+B)/3
pigment=(np.maximum(G,B)-R>8)&(light<175)
green=(G-R>6)&(G-B>3)&(light<175)
results=[]
for dx,dy in [(0,0),(-8,-8),(-8,8),(8,-8),(8,8)]:
    rx=x+rect[0]-cx-dx
    ry=y+rect[1]-cy-dy
    rad=np.hypot(rx,ry)
    theta=np.degrees(np.arctan2(rx,-ry))
    theta=np.where(theta<spokes[0],theta+360,theta)
    sectors=[]
    for a,b in zip(spokes,spokes[1:]):
        m=(theta>a+5)&(theta<b-5)&(rad>90)&(rad<225)
        g,n=label(pigment&m)
        largest=np.bincount(g[g!=0],minlength=2).max()/m.sum()
        sectors.append(dict(approx_spoke_bounds_deg=[a,b],pixels=int(m.sum()),
                             blue_green_dark_area_fraction=float(pigment[m].mean()),
                             green_dark_area_fraction=float(green[m].mean()),
                             largest_blue_green_piece_fraction=float(largest),
                             median_rgb_light=float(np.median(light[m]))))
    results.append(dict(hub_offset_native_xy=[dx,dy],sectors=sectors))
out=dict(
    analysis="Approximate RGB proxy applied only to the central sector annulus and trimmed visual spoke angles. This measures visible chroma and darkness, not paint chemistry or originality.",
    raw_source=aux['source'],spoke_angle_edge_trim_deg=5,radial_range_native_px=[90,225],
    proxy_any_blue_green_dark="max(G,B)−R > 8 and RGB-average below 175",
    proxy_green_dark="G−R > 6 and G−B > 3 and RGB-average below 175",
    results=results,
)
(p/'radial_sector_chroma.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')

detail.statement: Two independent image-only gap traces find enlarged spaces in all three circular text bands near scan-up and at upper left. In the main trace the widths are 4.75°, 5.25°, 6.55° at scan-up and 8.0°, 8.0°, 5.9° at upper left, outer to inner. The shared angular intersection is 0.65° versus 5.9°, sensitive to about 1° per manual ink edge but similar after a small change of polar center. Subsequent alignment of the words on both sides places all three ZL ring-locus starts at the upper-left corridor near 11:00. Eight cream rays and a green-dense, comparatively star-poor sector near scan-up are visible. Twenty-eight green caps were found under two component filters with manual artifact checks. The cap at f69v.9 is nearest scan-up among the four aligned top loci, while the f69v.9 and f69v.10 ink groups have opposite and nearly equal absolute bearings. The estimate cannot rank them by absolute bearing. The f69v.31 to .4 cap spacing of 16.06° is the second widest of 28, with continuous light/dark alternation. Ring writing runs clockwise and the individual radial words are read inward. The scan supports geometric candidates and leaves a unique radial sequence beginning or clockwise traversal unestablished.

experiment.json.summary: Two enlarged ring-gap corridors and an unresolved radial reading origin on f69v are mapped from the native scan.

step.json.check: Independently repeat with a high-resolution unwarped image, fixed radial word and cap anchoring, blind inking, and angle perturbations. Distinguish the upper-left transcriber start from the upper painted sector corridor. If a specific historical-roster hypothesis uses these cues, register the physical criterion, each permitted start and direction, and its uncertainty before consulting the roster; retain wider alternatives when no independent direction marker exists. Treat f69v.31 to .4 as a candidate geometric boundary whose normal alternation and nonunique spacing require separate evidence. Do not retrospectively narrow an existing exhaustive scan’s multiplicity.
step.json.limitations: The northern intersection depends on how faint coherent ink is delimited; its nominal overlap is below conservative manual edge tolerance. Top group angles cannot put f69v.8 strictly ahead of f69v.11 by proximity to vertical. The polar geometry assumes a common central hub for drawing and writing even though a free band fit drifts between rings. RGB is not a pigment assay. Independently reproduced positions and transcriber ordering do not prove design intention. The apparent reading direction of one engraved or written line does not order the neighboring radial lines.

methods.alignment: After saving the image-only readings, match closure/opening group shapes in ZL loci f69v.1–3 to either corridor and compare rectified inward radial groups to ZL loci f69v.31 then .4 through .11. Review IT, RF and GC locus IDs as separate transcription conventions. All four witnesses have 28 radial loci; only ZL supplies explicit clock comments here.
methods.blind_phase: Two separate ring readings and an additional radial reader worked on image-only crops. Gap angles follow manual boundaries of coherent upright brown strokes in unwrapped images. View uncertain strokes separately. The primary nearest-word comparison uses the median painted ink pixels of a manually delimited radial group. Angles are clockwise from the image vertical and are not the manuscript’s intrinsic coordinates.
methods.controls: Compare the nearby ordinary ink gaps measured on the same unwrapping, re-angle the main endpoints around an alternative hub, compare both 28-cap gap counts, and compare cap vs ink bearings. No mansion names or scores were used.
methods.paint: One fixed RGB/luminance threshold over the partial center annulus gives .831 in the top sector and .655 in the northwest. A second frame and green-specific hue proxy give the top sector .362 and the next-highest sector .158; a generic dark blue/green mask gives .573 top compared to .613 northwest. Registration and color definitions are approximate. A distinct sensitivity uses square patches and nine thresholds.

Unwrap x=1128+r*sin(theta), y=1150-r*cos(theta) in crop coordinates at 0.1 degree and 1 pixel. Estimate gap bounds by coherent exterior stroke edges in the unwrapped ribbons. Allow approximately 1 degree per edge for faded marks; do not equate gaps to exact pixel-total absence.

Ring writing direction does not establish circular order of spatially separate radial words, or that any gap establishes a semantic beginning.

Northwest neighbor also contains considerable dark blue and retains visible motif detail. Zero-degree corridor overlap is narrow. Broader upper-left gaps are not visibly accompanied by the special central fill. The direction of radial layout is not implied by glyph orientation. Eight cream radial rays were counted; their tips are diffuse and several meet the colored wheel.

ordinary_spacing.note: Ten nearby short blank intervals and both corridors measured in the same star-centered polar raster. They are separations between visible clusters, not claims about lexical tokenization. Edges to about one degree; intervals with strokes too faint to locate were skipped.

left_boundary.observation: The long blue cap at .31 and next short pale cap at .4 are visually adjacent in the same alternating cycle. The .31 word has two clear-looking inward groups, while .4 has a possible narrow division. This angular spacing is on the large side of the normal cap distribution and is not unique. No conspicuous keyed radial direction change is visible in the sampled strip.

radial_alignment.notes: Glyph shapes were read inward in rectified local strips and matched clockwise in order to the nearby ZL entries only after the geometry was locked. The distinctive paired .31 mark and paired-looking .4 sit on the same local sequence as .5 through .9. Clock labels are approximate, not angular measurements. .9 is the cap closest to scan-up but the ink centers of .9 and .10 have almost equal absolute angles (about six degrees); the difference is beneath localization and center uncertainty.

radial_sector_chroma.analysis: Approximate RGB proxy applied only to the central sector annulus and trimmed visual spoke angles. This measures visible chroma and darkness, not paint chemistry or originality.
radial_sector_chroma.proxy_green_dark: G−R > 6 and G−B > 3 and RGB-average below 175

import math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FILE = PATH / 'blind/ink-wheel-native.jpg'
CROP_OFFSET = (750, 590)
CENTER = (1128, 1150)
RGB = np.array(Image.open(FILE).convert('RGB'))

def polar(amin, amax, inner, outer, step=0.1):
    theta = np.arange(amin, amax, step)
    t = np.radians(theta)
    r = np.arange(outer,inner,-1)
    x = CENTER[0] + r[:, None] * np.sin(t)
    y = CENTER[1] - r[:, None] * np.cos(t)
    arr = np.stack([map_coordinates(RGB[:, :, channel], [y,x], order=1)
                    for channel in range(3)],axis=2)
    return theta,r,arr

def plot(amin, amax, inner, outer, prefix, step=.1):
    a,r,rgb = polar(amin,amax,inner,outer,step)
    img = Image.new('RGB', (len(a),len(r)+28), 'white')
    img.paste(Image.fromarray(rgb),(0,28))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for t in range(amin,amax,5 if amax-amin<=180 else 15):
        x = int(round((t-amin)/step))
        d.text((x+2,3),str(t),fill='black')
        d.line((x,19,x,28),fill='black')
    img.save(PATH / f'{prefix}.jpg',quality=96)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    plot(-60,60,730,1120,'ink-north-rings')
    plot(-180,180,55,265,'ink-star-polar',.25)
    for amin in range(-180,180,90):
        plot(amin,amin+90,700,1130,f'ink-ring-{amin:+d}')

import argparse
from math import asin, atan2, cos, degrees, hypot, radians, sin
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
import json
import re

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def angle(point, center):
    return degrees(atan2(point[0]-center[0],center[1]-point[1]))

def span(intervals):
    left,right=max(a for a,_ in intervals),min(b for _,b in intervals)
    return [left,right],right-left

def transform_deg(theta,r,old,new):
    t=radians(theta)
    xy=old[0]+r*sin(t),old[1]-r*cos(t)
    return angle(xy,new)

def colors(img, targets, center):
    grid=np.asarray(img.convert('RGB'), dtype=float)
    results={}
    for site in targets:
        a=radians(site['angle'])
        ctrx,ctry=round(center[0]+sin(a)*site['r']),round(center[1]-cos(a)*site['r'])
        vals=grid[ctry-24:ctry+25,ctrx-24:ctrx+25]
        patch=np.mean(vals,axis=(0,1))
        dominance=(vals[:,:,1]+vals[:,:,2])/2-vals[:,:,0]
        brightness=vals.mean(axis=2)
        quantile_xyz=[]
        for d in (2,8,14):
            for lum in (120,150,180):
                quantile_xyz.append({'dominance':d,'mean_rgb_limit':lum,
                    'fraction':float(np.mean((dominance>d)&(brightness<lum)))})
        results[site['name']]=dict(centre_local_xy=[ctrx,ctry],mean_rgb=patch.tolist(), thresholds=quantile_xyz)
    return results

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('image',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('points',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('transcriptions',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('radial_alignment',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('radial_geometry',type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('ring_spacing',type=Path)
    args=ap.parse_args()
    original=json.loads(args.points.read_text())
    b=original['basis']
    c,alt=b['center_local_xy'],b['alt_center_local_xy']
    radii={'outer':1015,'middle':950,'inner':850}
    gap_results={}
    for name,gaps in original['manual_gaps_deg'].items():
        cover,w=span(list(gaps.values()))
        alt_intervals={k:[transform_deg(t,radii[k],c,alt) for t in ts] for k,ts in gaps.items()}
        other,uw=span(list(alt_intervals.values()))
        gap_results[name]=dict(widths={k:b-a for k,(a,b) in gaps.items()},all_three_intersection=cover,
            intersection_width=w,alternative_center_intervals=alt_intervals,alternative_intersection=other,
            alternative_intersection_width=uw)
    timings={}
    for view,file in (('ZL','ZL3b-n.txt'),('IT','IT2a-n.txt'),('RF','RF1b-e.txt'),('GC','GC2a-n.txt')):
        lines=re.findall(r'^<(f69v\.\d+),[^>]*R[^>]*>[^\S\n]*([^\n]*)',
                         (args.transcriptions/file).read_text(),flags=re.M)
        records=[(id_,*m.groups()) for id_,body in lines
                 if (m:=re.match(r'<!(\d\d):(\d\d)>',body))]
        candidates=[(id_,float((int(h)*30+float(m)/2+180)%360-180)) for id_,h,m in records]
        timings[view]=dict(radial_loci=len(lines),explicit_clock_positions=len(candidates),
            top_3_clock_positions=sorted(candidates,key=lambda a:abs(a[1]))[:3],
            origin_1030_1130=[x for x in candidates if -45<=x[1]<=-15],
            compared_loci={id_:body for id_,body in lines if int(id_.split('.')[1]) in (4,7,8,9,10,11,31)})
    aligned=json.loads(args.radial_alignment.read_text())
    geo=json.loads(args.radial_geometry.read_text())
    labels=[e for e in aligned['loci_after_zl_alignment'] if e['locus'] in
            {f'f69v.{i}' for i in (8,9,10,11)}]
    cap_order=sorted(x['bearing_deg'] for x in geo['caps'])
    cap_gaps=[b-a for a,b in zip(cap_order,cap_order[1:]+[cap_order[0]+360])]
    near=[]
    for label in labels:
        xy=label['native_ink_group_xy']
        h=geo['radial_hub_native_xy']
        toler=label['approximately_ink_localization_tolerance_px']+geo['hub_uncertainty_px']
        estimate=angle(xy,h)
        delta=degrees(asin(toler/hypot(xy[0]-h[0],xy[1]-h[1])))
        near.append(dict(locus=label['locus'],azimuth_deg=estimate,
                         conservative_localization_interval_deg=[estimate-delta,estimate+delta]))
    neighbors=json.loads(args.ring_spacing.read_text())
    neighbor_summary={k:dict(count=len(x),median=median(b-a for a,b in x),maximum=max(b-a for a,b in x))
                      for k,x in neighbors.items() if isinstance(x,list)}
    out=dict(gaps=gap_results,ordinary_spacing=neighbor_summary,
             cap_gap_span=[min(cap_gaps),median(cap_gaps),max(cap_gaps)],
             scanned_near_top_ink=near,
             pigment=colors(Image.open(args.image),original['central_pigment'],c),radial_clock=timings)
    print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

"""Image-only audit of the green caps and top radial ink on the Yale f69v crop."""
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import label, binary_opening, binary_closing, map_coordinates
from math import atan2, degrees, hypot
from hashlib import sha256
import json

work=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
raw=work/'blind/radial-full.jpg'
im=np.array(Image.open(raw)).astype(float)
origin=(750,620)
hub=(1882.,1746.)
native_height,native_width=im.shape[:2]
r,g,b=im.transpose(2,0,1)
y,x=np.indices(r.shape)
x=x+origin[0]
y=y+origin[1]
distance=np.hypot(x-hub[0],y-hub[1])
mask=(g-r>10)&(g-b>8)&(distance>380)&(distance<590)&(r+g+b<450)
mask=binary_closing(binary_opening(mask,iterations=2),iterations=4)
marks,k=label(mask)
components=[]
for i in range(1,k+1):
    yy,xx=np.where(marks==i)
    if len(yy)<=400:
        continue
    cx=origin[0]+xx.mean()
    cy=origin[1]+yy.mean()
    a=degrees(atan2(cx-hub[0],hub[1]-cy))
    radius=hypot(cx-hub[0],cy-hub[1])
    components.append(dict(bearing_deg=round(a,3),radius_px=round(radius,2),
                           center_xy=[round(cx,2),round(cy,2)],pixels=len(yy)))
# An isolated green mark on a bar farther inward and within four degrees
# of its cap is not a second cap. Confirm these two near-coincident pairs on
# the raw scan; very small isolated green marks account for no extra heads.
included=[]
excluded=[]
for q in sorted(components,key=lambda q:-q['radius_px']):
    other=next((p for p in included if abs(q['bearing_deg']-p['bearing_deg'])<4),None)
    if other is not None:
        excluded.append(dict(component=q,head_bearing=other['bearing_deg']))
        continue
    included.append(q)
included.sort(key=lambda q:q['bearing_deg'])
for i,q in enumerate(included):
    q['cw_rank_from_top_left']=((i-12)%len(included))+1
assert len(included)==28
ink=[]
# Delineate the visible top four word groups on a rectified view: radius
# outwards along x, clockwise tangent along y relative to each axis.
# Rows and boxes chosen from the image, without using any transliteration.
for axis,bbox in [(-18,(515,-19,734,36)),(-6,(599,-23,742,36)),
                  (5,(518,-35,720,39)),(16,(608,-29,748,39))]:
    theta=np.radians(axis)
    lo_u,lo_v,hi_u,hi_v=bbox
    uu=np.arange(lo_u,hi_u)[None,:]
    vv=np.arange(lo_v,hi_v)[:,None]
    x=hub[0]+uu*np.sin(theta)+vv*np.cos(theta)
    y=hub[1]-uu*np.cos(theta)+vv*np.sin(theta)
    rgb=np.stack([map_coordinates(im[:,:,j],(y-origin[1],x-origin[0]),order=1,cval=240)
                  for j in range(3)],axis=2)
    nr,ng,nb=rgb.transpose(2,0,1)
    keep=((nr+ng+nb)/3<175)&(nr-nb>18)&(nr>=ng)
    cx=float(np.median(x[keep]))
    cy=float(np.median(y[keep]))
    ink.append(dict(axis_deg=axis,local_roi_uv=list(bbox),ink_median_xy=[round(cx,1),round(cy,1)],
                    approximate_ink_bearing_deg=round(degrees(atan2(cx-hub[0],hub[1]-cy)),2),
                    pixels=int(keep.sum())))
out=dict(
    canvas="https://collections.library.yale.edu/manifests/oid/2002046/canvas/1006199",
    source="https://collections.library.yale.edu/iiif/2/1006199/750,620,2220,2210/full/0/default.jpg",
    raw_sha256=sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),native_crop_xywh=[*origin,native_width,native_height],
    wheel_panel_approx_bounds_native_xyxy=[620,130,3040,3730],
    drawing_ink_approx_bounds_native_xyxy=[850,680,2940,2750],
    radial_hub_native_xy=list(hub),hub_uncertainty_px=8,
    bearing_definition='degrees clockwise from scan up; x right, y down, angles wrapped [−180,180)',
    caps=included,excluded_inner_green_fragments=excluded,
    ink_top_four=ink,ink_group_uncertainty_px=15,
    approximate_cream_spoke_bearings_deg=[-171,-113,-72,-25,17,68,103,144],

    upper_sector="The contiguous blue-green section is between the roughly −25 and +17 degree cream spokes. Other sectors show blue blotches and small star figures, and some paint losses make intensity variable.",

Opposite orientation places the tall glyphs below. A radial baseline has no tangential writing vector; global order through the strips is a separate question.",
